The
CUHK Paediatric Allergy Team
is organizing
CU Allergy Week 2026
to enhance public awareness and education on allergic diseases, with the theme:

"Advances in Management and Prevention of Eczema and Food Allergy"
We warmly invite you to join the following CU Allergy Week activities ⏬⏬

Allergy Workshops
This workshop is designed for individuals living with allergic conditions, parents of children with allergies, as well as teaching and support staff from nurseries, kindergartens, and primary schools.
Date:
31 October 2026 (Saturday)
Session Times:
13:00-13:45 / 14:00-14:45 (45 minutes per session)
This year's workshop will cover two topics:
Eczema and Anaphylaxis
Asthma and Allergic Rhinitis

A Certificate of Attendance will be awarded to all participants.

https://registration.cuallergyweek2026.com/register

Join paediatric consultants from
CUHK Medical Centre
, professors from the
Department of Paediatrics at The Chinese University of Hong Kong

From initial concept development from science and validation to a business that is ready for the market, our Lab to Market approach walks scientists through the entire venture creation process.
Two training tracks – the
Venture Track
and the
Business Leaders Track
– are offered to support you in developing your ventures, strengthening venture readiness, and building capabilities needed to lead deep-tech ventures. You may choose the track that best suits your needs.
The
Venture Track
explores your commercialisation potential, navigate your commercialisation journey by aligning technical development with key business milestones and developing go-to-market strategies.
The
Business Leaders Track
focuses on real-world leadership challenges, strategic decision-making and operational execution in deep-tech start-ups.
Having completed the Training Session, you will be better equipped to build, commercialize and lead deep-tech ventures.
Are you ready to lead deep tech from lab to market? Apply now and kickstart your venture journey at CUHK Campus on 16–17 October 2026!

The Independent Learning Centre (ILC) offers a wide range of workshops and activities to support learning of language and communication skills. Visit our website for more information: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ (20261005)  - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【Weekly Highlights - English Section 】
A. Communication, Study Skills and Job Preparation Workshops
The Independent Learning Centre offers English workshops 5 October to 9 October: (1) Writing Success: Academic Essays, (2) Ace Your Oral Presentations, (3) Hong Kong Civil Service Interview Preparation, and (4) Global Citizenship Series: Fair Trade. These workshops are now available for registration at: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in English
Consultation service is available during the following time:
5 October (Mon): 10:30 – 12:30
6 October (Tue): 10:30 – 12:30
7 October (Wed): 10:30 – 12:30
8 October (Thu): 14:30 – 16:30
9 October (Fri): 14:30 – 16:30
Online Booking:
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
More Timeslot please check our website：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EH/consultation.aspx
====================================
【Weekly Highlights - Chinese Section 】中文部本週活動
A. Chinese Workshops 中文工作坊
The Independent Learning Centre offers Chinese workshops 5 October to 9 October: (1) JRE Argumentative Writing I, (2) Academic Writing: An Initial Exploration of Using Generative AI (PTH), and (3) Critical Thinking and Argumentative Writing. These workshops are now available for registration at: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
自學中心十月五日至十月九日舉辦 (1) JRE 議論文寫作 (一), (2) 學術寫作：使用生成式人工智能初探 (普), (3) 英文學術文獻的搜集、引用、表述與整理 (粵), (4) 「天下之能事畢矣」—— 《易經》占筮入門(粵), (5) 職涯發展支援系列 (CDFS): 葉劉淑儀和你爐邊對談, 及 (6) 批判思考與論點寫作等工作坊，歡迎報名。
登記連結： https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/workshops.aspx
B. Consultation Service in Chinese 自學中心中文輔導服務
Consultation service is available during the following time:
自學中心於十月五日至十月九日提供以下中文輔導時段。
5 October (Mon): 10:30 – 12:30 and 14:30 – 16:30
6 October (Tue): 10:30 – 12:30
7 October (Wed): 10:30 – 12:30 and 14:30 – 16:30
8 October (Thu): 14:30 – 16:30
網上預約：
https://ilccuhk.as.me/schedule.php
更多中文輔導時段。
====================================
C. “The Power of Words” 「書寫力量」
This is a reading and writing event organized by the ILC, Hong Kong Literature Research Centre, the Office of Arts Administrator (OAA) and Tolopoem. Activities we have this semester include Blackboard / Glass Wall Poems, Talks of Dialogue in the Arts and Workshops.
自學中心、香港文學研究中心、藝術行政主任辦公室及吐露詩社合辦的大型閱讀及寫作活動。這個學期的活動，除黑板詩及玻璃詩外，還有藝文縱談及各式工作坊。各項活動的資料可以參看：https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/CH/Event/thepowerofwords.aspx
====================================
【Independent Online Learning Resources】自學中心網上自學資源
A. Independent Online Learning Resources in English
- Academic Writing
Visit this link on academic writing skills and convention for different citation styles:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Writing.aspx
- Vocabulary
Visit this link for both General Vocabulary and Specific Vocabulary (e.g. For Business and Medical Professionals) lists and practices:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/Writing_Vocab.aspx
- Job Search and Interviews
Visit this link to identify your capabilities and personality types, learn how to prepare job search documents and personal statements, and how to get ready for job interviews:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/ENResources/JobSearching.aspx
B. Independent Online Learning Resources in Chinese中文網上自學材料
- Academic Writing論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on academic writing, with highlights on structure, expressions, common grammatical mistakes, etc.
針對大學生撰寫學術論文時所遇到的困難，提供實用的知識和練習。內容包括：學期論文的結構與寫作步驟、常見語法錯誤、表達與語言邏輯等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/AWOnline/general1.html
- ‘Pulewang’ Online Putonghua Platform「普樂網」網上普通話平台
An online Putonghua learning platform designed for CU students. Essential knowledge of Putonghua is introduced with interactive exercises and games. Extended conversational exchanges on selected topics of social affairs and student life are available for oral practice with texts and pinyin.
針對本校同學學習需要的網上普通話平台，內容圍繞大學生的學習與日常生活，設計深入淺出，每單元均有練習與遊戲，互動有趣，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/Chinese/plw/index.html
- Argumentative Writing議論文寫作
Visit this link for advice on the structure, the content and the language of argumentative writing.
介紹議論文的結構及寫作要求，以解說、例子及練習，呈現寫作議論時要注意的內容及語言特點：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/arguWriting/001.html

協助內地同學迅速掌握粵語發音。內容包括：語音基礎、粵普對比、難點練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/cantontones/_home/index.html

An interactive introduction to Hong Kong style Cantonese. Daily expressions and situational conversations are introduced with interactive exercises.
以有趣互動的方式介紹港式粵語，包括日常生活用語、情景會話、互動練習等，歡迎使用：http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/canton_express/others/frontpage.html
- Online Cantonese for Foreigners
A free online platform for international students to learn basic Cantonese. The texts are clear and simple, and interactive exercises easy to use: http://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/chinese/can_eng/layout.html
- Online Putonghua for Foreigners
Do you know how to make orders in a Chinese restaurant and learn how to bargain when you travel in China? Here are some situational conversations and basic knowledge of Putonghua to learn online: https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/EN/CHResources/Lang_PTH_EnglishSpk.aspx
- Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) 中國語言及文化自學資源網
Online Platform for Successful Chinese Learning (OPSCL) is a biliterate (English and Chinese) online platform that contains reviews of learning materials suitable for autodidactic study in the 5 big areas of Mandarin, Cantonese, Chinese Characters, Chinese Culture, and Hong Kong Culture. Electronic learning materials that is good for self-learning would be review. Each review consists of a description and other useful information. Users can search for resources by various criteria, rate the resources, and write their own comments. A self-assessment system is also provided so as to recommend an entry point to the users according to their current level.
中國語言及文化自學資源網(OPSCL)為一推薦自學資源之網上平台。平台為有意學習普通話、粵語、漢字、中國文化或香港文化等五大範疇的人士提供中文及英文雙語之學習資源，以推動自主學習與終身學習。平台內推薦的資源均附有簡介及評語，使用者可按自身需要搜尋學習資源，並在使用後給予評分或評論，以備其他使用者參考。此外，平台設有「自評系統」，使用者可通過完成自評，確定自身的學習起步點，從而尋找適合自己程度的學習資源。

職涯發展及持續進修支援系列
2026-27

- Dr. Richard Eng
教你心態境界
LEVEL UP
起點不決定終點，關鍵在於你能走多遠！
升級你的心態境界 — 讓伍經衡博士（Dr. Richard Eng）帶你 Level Up！
從草根家庭背景出發，伍博士（即補習天王 — Dr. Richard Eng）將一間補習學校發展成上市公司，其後更於香港大學取得教育博士學位（EdD）, 並榮獲「2024–25 年度最佳博士論文獎」。如今他亦積極投身於懲教署的志願服務。這正是個人、專業及職涯成長中「永不停步、不斷 Level Up」的最佳寫照！
歡迎參與「職涯發展及持續進修支援系列」（CDFS）第 3 場講座：

Dr. Richard Eng
教你心態境界
Level Up
精彩內容包括：
真實人生歷程 — 從草根背景邁向卓越成就
打造升級心態 — 如何在個人與專業領域實現 Level Up
前瞻洞見分享 — 涵蓋持續進修、終身學習與職涯成長
即場問答環節 — 與伍博士親身交流
地點： 大學圖書館 進學園 VR Zone
日期： 2026年10月14日（星期三）
⏰ 時間： 下午 4:30 – 5:30
語言： 英語及廣東話
準備好要 Level Up 未？
立即報名，尋找啟發：
https://ilc.link/CDFS3

如欲了解更多「職涯發展及持續進修支援系列 2026-27」的資訊，請瀏覽：
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/workshop/cdfs/

Career Development & Further Studies Series 2026-27

- Level Up with Dr. Richard Eng
It's not where you start. It's how far you go.
Level Up Your Mindset — and let Dr. Richard Eng show you how.
From a grassroots family background, Dr. Eng (aka 補習天王 — The "Tutor King") turned a tutorial school into a listed company, earned an EdD from HKU with the Best Doctoral Thesis Award 2024–25, and continues to give back to the society through volunteering with the Correctional Services Department. A true testament of continuously levelling up!
Join us for Talk #3 of our Career Development & Further Studies (CDFS) Series:

Level Up with Dr. Richard Eng
What to Expect:
A real-life journey — from grassroots to remarkable life achievement
How to build a Level Up mindset professionally and personally
Insights on lifelong learning, further studies & career growth
Live Q&A with Dr. Eng
Venue: VR Zone, Learning Garden, CUHK Library
Date: 14 Oct 2026 (Wed)
⏰ Time: 4:30 – 5:30 pm
Language: English & Cantonese
Are you ready to Level Up?
Register now and get inspired -
https://ilc.link/CDFS3

For more information about the Career Development & Further Studies Series 2026-27, please visit:
https://www.ilc.cuhk.edu.hk/workshop/cdfs/

jcsath@cuhk.edu.hk

超越現實的畫作：藝術
×
混合實境
（Mixed Reality）體驗

誠邀你參加一個結合藝術同混合實境（MR）科技嘅創意工作坊，與來自不同文化背景的朋友一同創作一幅屬於大家的立體藝術作品，共同描繪香港故事。
參加者將透過 MR 技術在同一個實體及虛擬空間進行 3D 繪畫，分享自己對香港的回憶、感受、生活點滴和想法。你可以自由創作、與其他參加者合作，或者在之前參加者的作品上加入新元素。隨著創作慢慢累積，一幅集合不同文化背景、不同生活經歷的大型立體藝術作品將會逐步形成。
體驗嶄新混合實境（MR）科技
在沉浸式空間進行 3D 創作
用藝術分享你眼中的香港
與不同文化背景的參加者互動交流
無需任何藝術或科技經驗
歡迎所有文化背景人士參加。
即使你不想親身創作，都歡迎以觀賞者身份參與，透過觀賞專用頭戴裝置欣賞創作過程，以及不斷演變的立體藝術作品。

日期
：
2026年10月15日（星期四）
⏰
時間
：
下午2:00 至 5:30

地點
：
鰂魚涌海濱活動空間 Quarryside  舍區 活動室 1 至 3（鰂魚涌海善里 20 號）

名額
：
20位參加者

語言:
英語為主 (現場設有廣東話及南亞語言翻譯)
一齊探索藝術和科技如何促進跨文化交流，透過創作認識彼此，從不同角度重新欣賞香港！

報名連結
：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0TGkqUSP8Dc5WqW

報名截止日期：
2026年10月4日（星期日）

查詢：
JCSATH WhatsApp 6104 9535
注意事項
• 名額有限，先到先得。
• 成功報名者將於活動最少2日前收到 WhatsApp 確認通知。如未收到確認訊息，則表示未能成功獲得名額。
無需
任何繪畫技巧或科技知識，只要帶住你的好奇心、創意，和屬於你的香港故事一同參與
！

=====================================================================

Drawing Beyond Reality: Art & MR Experience

What does Hong Kong look like through your eyes?
Join us for a unique
Mixed Reality (MR) art workshop
where people from different cultural backgrounds come together to create a shared
3D artwork
about life in Hong Kong.
Using
MR technology
, participants will draw and create in the
same physical and virtual space
, expressing their memories, experiences, feelings, and perspectives of Hong Kong. You may create your own artwork, collaborate with others, or add to drawings created by previous participants. Together, we will build a collective 3D artwork that reflects the
diverse stories
and voices of our community.
Experience Mixed Reality technology
Create artwork in a 3D immersive space
Explore memories, experiences, hopes, and everyday life in Hong Kong
No art or technology experience required
Participate as a creator or observer
We welcome participants from all cultural backgrounds, including
members from multicultural communities
and Chinese communities.
Even if you do not wish to create artwork yourself, you can still join as an observer and explore the evolving virtual artwork through dedicated observation headsets.

Date:
15 October 2026 (Thursday)
⏰
Time:
2:00 PM - 5:30 PM

Venue:
Quarryside

Quota:
20 registered participants

Language:
English (interpretation available in Cantonese and South Asian languages)
Come and explore how art and technology can bring people together, spark conversations, and help us see Hong Kong through one another's eyes.
Register here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0TGkqUSP8Dc5WqW
Registration Deadline: 4 October 2026 (Sunday)
Enquiries: JCSATH WhatsApp 6104 9535
Notes
• Due to limited places, registration is on a first-come, first-served basis.
• Successful registrants will receive a WhatsApp confirmation at least 2 days before the event. If you do not receive a confirmation message, your registration is considered unsuccessful.
Open to people from all cultural backgrounds. Let's explore our stories, communities, and experiences together through creativity and technology.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

Announcements
Helpers Wanted 招募學生助教 (HK$84/hr) 招募學生參與「中小學GenAI親子工作坊」助教及培訓計劃（提供服務證書及酬金）  - Centre for Learning Enhancement And Research
From: JC GoAI Project 「賽馬會人工智能教育」計劃
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
jcgoai-engagement@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
(Only Chinese version is available )
香港中文大學學能提升研究中心 ｜招募學生參與「中小學
GenAI
親子工作坊」助教及培訓計劃（提供服務證書及酬金）
鑑於生成式AI（GenAI）在教育界的應用日益普及，學能提升研究中心（Centre for Learning Enhancement and Research）正與過百間中、小學合作，針對家長及學生舉辦一系列「GenAI親子工作坊」。工作坊由擁有19年教學經驗、曾獲行政長官卓越教學獎的資深教師設計及主講。
本中心期望招募對電子教學及人工智能輔助教學充滿熱誠的學生，成為工作坊的助教，幫助家長與學生正確掌握AI工具（如Gemini），提升學習效能並關注相關的資訊素養。
參與是次助教及培訓計劃的學生(2026/27學年)，將獲得以下寶貴機會：
專業認證：
支援最少3場工作坊或參與指定時數的相關教學設計後，將獲本中心頒發服務證書。
實習津貼：
在培訓及擔任工作坊助手期間，均可獲每小時港幣
84元
的酬金。
名師指導：
直接向獲獎名師學習教學實戰經驗，了解前線教學法。
前線體驗：
於中小學及中文大學校園內協助工作坊，親身接觸家長與學生，累積溝通與教學經驗。
參與計劃的學生須符合以下條件：
符合資格參加 香港中文大學「學生助理參與計劃」並已登記成為學生助理的全日制本科生（二年級或以上）或研究生均可報名參加；
操流利廣東話，能使用英語及普通話作簡單溝通；
掌握資訊科技教育及最新人工智能趨勢，樂於與學生及家長交流，熱衷於分享和展示人工智能的有效操作；
有補習、教學或編寫教學材料經驗者將有優勢；及
已完成認證為「
Gemini Certified Student (For University Students)
」。
有興趣參加的學生，請填妥以下報名表格。名額有限，將按遞交順序處理，額滿即止。
https://forms.gle/DDKsXvjVq1KhLFdj7
查詢：
Ms. Man TSANG 4481 2115 （電話/WhatsApp）/ mantsang@cuhk.edu.hk (電郵)

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

title: 拍片唔難：影片製作入門工作坊系列 Filming Made Easy: Introduction to Video Production Workshop Series
bodyText:
Mass Mail System

Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students

2026/10/02

Seminars / Forums / Programmes / Workshops
拍片唔難：影片製作入門工作坊系列 Filming Made Easy: Introduction to Video Production Workshop Series   - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

拍片唔難：影片製作入門工作坊系列

對影視製作有興趣，甚至想投身媒體行業，但又唔知由邊度開始？中大嘅朋友，不妨先由了解一下幕後製作。
《拍片唔難：影片製作入門工作坊系列》首場分享會，邀請兩位業內嘉賓分享製作經驗，帶你走一趟由創意同埋構思開始、再變成節目嘅幕後製作過程，講座重會分享行業挑戰，同埋入行前值得了解嘅事。
首場分享會，你將會瞭解到：
由構思到製作｜一個節目點樣從零開始，逐步成形？
行業現況與挑戰｜面對瞬息萬變嘅媒體環境，製作人點樣應對？
入行建議與準備｜有志投身影視行業，可以點樣踏出第一步？
嘉賓講者
林肯
｜資深影視監製 / 導演
由綜藝資訊小 PA 起步，轉戰戲劇部晉升至導演、監製，近年更曾擔任 MyTVSuper 創作總監。
監製作品：《香港愛情故事》、《婚後事》、《青春不要臉》
黃秉怡
｜前 TVB 資深總編劇（編審）
中大中國語言及文學系校友，畢業後投身電視台，挑戰最貼地的文字工作 - 通俗電視劇，由編劇一路走到編審，堅持用心寫好每一句對白。
編審作品：《BB來了》、《婚後事》

ilc.link/filming

想踏出影視創作嘅第一步，就不能錯過，名額有限，報名從速！

They will guide you through the behind-the-scenes creative process—from initial ideas and concepts to the final broadcasted show—while sharing industry challenges and essential insights you should know before entering the field.

Looking for some time to relax, recharge, and focus on your wellbeing?
Join us for a special Yoga & Tea Tasting Workshop as part of
JCSATH Multicultural Awareness Week 2026
. This beginner-friendly session combines gentle restorative yoga with a mindful tea tasting experience to support both physical and mental wellbeing.
Date: 12 October 2026 (Monday)
Time: 10:00 a.m. - 11:30 a.m.
Venue: Quarryside, 20 Hoi Shin Lane, Quarry Bay
Instructor: Female Instructor from Curiouslyoga
Language: English
Quota: 15 female participants only
No previous yoga experience is required. Beginners are warmly welcome!
The workshop includes:
Gentle restorative yoga practice
Relaxation and mindfulness exercises
Guided tea tasting experience
A chance to connect with women from different cultural backgrounds
What to wear:
Participants are encouraged to wear comfortable clothing suitable for light stretching and movement (e.g. T-shirt, sportswear, leggings, loose trousers). Please avoid restrictive clothing. No special yoga equipment is required.

https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_d4EdKaH4WmLV1YO

We look forward to spending a peaceful and refreshing morning with you!

From: The Jockey Club S.A.T.H. Project for Healthy Families (JCSATH)
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
jcsath@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

Women's Voices, Shared Stories

一人一故事劇場 (Playback Theatre) 體驗

「一人一故事劇場 (Playback Theatre)」(「一劇場」)是一種即興演出的劇場形式，結合了劇場、心理劇與原始民族聚會的儀式和精神。 在「一劇場」演出裡，主持人 會邀請玩場觀眾分享個人經歷，演出者隨即主動開放地聆聽、並以尊重的態度即興運用形體動作、音樂、戲劇的形式將故事演繹出來，作為禮物回饋觀眾的真誠分享。過程中，不同人士的真實生命經驗彷彿在互相對話，創造了一個空間，讓信任、人與人之間的共鳴共感，在整個群體中流動。
「一劇場」相信每個人都有故事可說，也有被聆聽的需要。
每個「一劇場」的演出都是一個連結過去、回應當下、擁抱未知的共同經歷；讓觀眾和演出者在分享與聆聽、展現與觀看的過程中，一同拆開生命和生活給所有人的寶貝、凝聚社群。
您是否曾希望有一個空間，能與其他女性交流、分享生活經驗，並感受到被聆聽和理解？
誠邀您參加這個溫暖而富創意的工作坊，讓來自不同文化背景的女性透過簡單的劇場活動互相認識、交流和學習。
無需任何戲劇或表演經驗
可自願選舉分享個人故事
可按照自己感到舒適的程度參與
在安全、支持和友善的環境中認識新朋友
透過劇場遊戲、故事分享、身體活動及小組反思，我們將一起探索女性在日常生活中的經歷、挑戰、力量與希望。

日期：
2026年10月11日（星期日）
⏰
時間：
下午3:00至6:00

地點：
鰂魚涌海濱活動空間 Quarryside  舍區 活動室 1 至 3（鰂魚涌海善里 20 號)

名額：
30位女性參加者

語言:
英語為主 (現場設有廣東話及南亞語言翻譯)
歡迎所有女性參加。無論您想分享、參與活動，還是單純聆聽，都非常歡迎您的加入。

歡迎攜同子女一同參與。

報名連結
：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0NfnDMKpKfjHgqy

查詢：
JCSATH WhatsApp 6104 9535
期待與您一起分享故事、建立連結，並發現彼此的共同點

Women's Voices, Shared Stories
Playback theatre workshop
"Playback Theatre" — a form of improvisational theatre where actors listen, interpret, and use a range of expression methods and techniques to re-enact stories told live by the audience.
Have you ever wanted a space to connect with other women, share experiences, and feel heard?
Join us for a gentle and creative workshop for women from different cultural backgrounds to connect, share, and learn from one another through simple theatre activities.
No acting or theatre experience needed
Sharing personal stories is completely voluntary
Participate at your own comfort level
Meet new friends in a safe and supportive space
Through theatre games, storytelling, movement, and group reflection, we will explore women's everyday experiences, challenges, strengths, and hopes.
Date: 11 October 2026 (Sunday)
⏰ Time: 3:00 PM - 6:00 PM
Venue: Activity Room 1–3, Quarryrside, 20 Hoi Shin Lane, Quarry Bay
Quota: 30 female participants only
Language:  English (interpretation available in Cantonese and South Asian languages)
All women are welcome. Come as you are, whether you'd like to share, participate, or simply listen.
You are welcome to bring your children with you.
Register here:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_0NfnDMKpKfjHgqy
For enquiry, please contact JCSATH Whatsapp 61049535.

bodyText:

午間花藝靜觀 給自己花時間：找回心花怒放的我 Midday Floral Mindfulness Give Yourself "Flower Time": Rediscover Your Inner Blooming Self   - ILC
From: ILC
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ilc-counsel@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -

給自己花時間：找回心花怒放的我

花一個下午，默默穿透話語，引用花的形態及靜觀小練習，直接感受美好，學會善待自己，重遇內心明媚時光。
工作坊詳情
日期： 2026年10月29日（星期四）
⏰ 時間： 下午 12:30 – 2:30
地點： 大學圖書館地庫進學園進台階
語言： 粵語
# 每位報名者將獲贈兩枝鮮花，用於正念冥想練習。
導師簡介
楊幗慧 Ada Yeung
-             花藝師、花療靜觀創立人及園藝治療分享者。
-             香港80年老字號花店（Anglo Chinese Florist）第三代傳人。
-             自幼研習繪畫與手藝，及逾十年的禪修冥想經歷，有感鮮花亦是是修心靜觀、令人快樂及美學兼備的手藝。
-             希望推動更多人透過禪修、花藝及大自然美學探索自我和找回內在平靜，為社會帶來更多減壓和諧空間。
報名詳情：
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/event?id=116945

Taking the Time to Unwind and Reconnect with Your Inner Self through Flowers

Through the different senses of flowers and gentle mindfulness practices, let’s experience beauty, learn to treat ourselves kindly, and enjoy a moment of peace together.
Workshop Details
Date: 29 October 2026 (Thu)
⏰ Time: 12:30 pm – 2:30 pm
Venue: The Forum, Learning Garden, LG/F, University Library
Language: Cantonese
# Each registrant will be given two stalks of flowers for mindfulness practices.
About the Speaker
Ada Yeung
Florist, Horticultural Therapy Practitioner, and Founder of Floral Mindfulness.
Third-generation successor of Anglo Chinese Florist, an 80-year legacy florist in Hong Kong.
With a background in painting and handicrafts since childhood and over a decade of meditation practice, Ada deeply believes that floral art brings about aesthetic beauty and inner peace.
Dedicated to guiding individuals to discover subtle beauty through meditation, floral arrangement, and natural aesthetics, Ada hopes to co-create harmony in society with event attendees.
Registration Details:
https://webapp.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/ras/restricted/event?id=116945

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

title: Native English Speaker Wanted for a Child Language Research Recording (HKD67 per hour) 招募英語母語者錄製兒童語言研究材料(每小時67元津貼)
bodyText:

Announcements
Native English Speaker Wanted for a Child Language Research Recording (HKD67 per hour) 招募英語母語者錄製兒童語言研究材料(每小時67元津貼) - Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages
From: YANG Wenwen
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
wenwenyang@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學語⾔學及現代語⾔系現正籌備⼀項詞彙判斷實驗研究團隊現正招募一名英語母語者，錄製簡短英語句子，作為研究兒童在背景說話聲中辨認英語的聆聽材料。
錄音者條件：
年滿18歲，英語為母語；
能以清晰、自然的語氣朗讀簡短句子，並保持相對穩定的口音及語速；
願意提供一小段試錄音，供研究團隊評估錄音是否適合本研究。
有興趣者請填寫登記表https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cUUghNXylNR6O2y。
合適的登記者將獲聯絡，安排簡短試錄音；獲選者其後將於梁銶琚樓參加一次約一小時的正式錄音，朗讀約80句適合兒童理解的英語句子，例如 “The boy is washing the car.”
正式錄音按實際錄音時間以每小時港幣67元計算報酬。登記表所收集的個人資料只用於招募、篩選及聯絡，並會保密處理。正式錄音及錄音材料的使用安排將於錄音前另行說明及徵求同意。
如有查詢，請電郵楊雯雯：wenwenyang@cuhk.edu.hk。
The Department of Linguistics and Modern Languages at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is recruiting a native English speaker to record short sentences for a study of how children recognise English speech when other people are talking.
Speaker eligibility:
Aged 18 or above and a native English speaker;
Able to read short sentences clearly and naturally, with a reasonably consistent accent and speaking rate;
Willing to provide a brief voice sample so the research team can assess suitability for the study.
If you are interested, please complete the registration form: https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_cUUghNXylNR6O2y.
Suitable applicants will be contacted for a brief voice screening. The selected speaker will then attend one recording session of approximately one hour at Leung Kau Kui Building and read around 80 child-friendly English sentences, such as “The boy is washing the car.”
The formal recording will be compensated at HK$67 per hour, based on the actual recording time. Personal information submitted through the registration form will be used only for recruitment, screening and contact, and will be handled confidentially. The recording procedure and use of the recordings will be explained separately before consent is obtained.
For enquiries, please email Wenwen Yang at wenwenyang@cuhk.edu.hk.

⭐【Call for Registrations】Masterclass with CUHK Artist-in-Residence 2026 Jen Shyu – “Intensive Ear and Rhythm Training for Composing and Improvising” (7 Oct) ⭐【報名參加】中大駐校藝術家計劃：徐秋雁大師班 – 「聲律幾何：聽覺與節奏訓練」（10月7日） - Faculty of Arts
From: Artist-in-Residence Programme
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
airp@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
2026年度中大駐校藝術家計劃誠邀大家參加本年度
駐校藝術家徐秋雁
主持的大師班 – 「聲律幾何：聽覺與節奏訓練」。
本大師班歡迎所有音樂愛好者和音樂人參加。徐秋雁將以音高與節奏音程等基本樂理元素為重點，帶領參加者進行一系列富趣味的聽覺與節奏訓練。同學可透過這套多元且具創意的練習方法，更有效強化「內在聽覺」與「內在節奏」，加深聽覺、聲音、心智與身體之間的連結，進一步提升作曲與即興演奏的能力。
日期：2026年10月7日 (星期三)
時間：下午2:30 – 4:30
地點：香港中文大學許讓成樓LG01室
名額︰25
語言︰英語
報名（10月5日截止）︰
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737060
課堂要求及重要事項：
1. 參加者須具備十二平均律（12-TET）下基本音程的概念（例如半音、全音、小三度、純四度等，可參照鋼琴鍵盤），並能唱出上述音程（不必具備專業歌唱技巧）。
2. 請攜帶您的樂器出席課堂。場地備有鋼琴。
3. 參加者會被要求演唱及演奏樂器。
如有查詢，請電郵至
airp@cuhk.edu.hk
。
有關徐秋雁：
https://www.jenshyu.com/
有關中大駐校藝術家計劃︰
https://www.arts.cuhk.edu.hk/web/zh-hant/cuhk-artist-in-residence
We warmly invite you to join the
Masterclass –
“
Intensive Ear and Rhythm Training for Composing and Improvising”
, led by
Jen Shyu, CUHK Artist-in-Residence 2026
.
This masterclass is open to all musicians, including singers, instrumentalists, singer-songwriters. Through fun exercises based on fundamental building blocks of music (pitch and rhythmic intervals), Jen Shyu offers a more holistic and creative approach to ear training than conventional methods. These exercises strengthen “inner hearing” and “inner rhythm,” deepening the connection between ear, voice, mind, and body to support more confident composing and improvising.
Date: 7 October 2026 (Wednesday)
Time: 2:30 – 4:30 pm
Venue: LG01, Hui Yeung Shing Building (HYS), CUHK
Quota: 25
Language: English
Registration (by 5 October):
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13737060
Requirements & Important Notes:
Participants should have a basic understanding of intervals in 12-tone equal temperament (12-TET) (e.g., semitone/half-step, whole-step, minor third, perfect fourth).
Participants should be able to sing these intervals (strong vocal technique is not required).
Please bring your music instrument to attend the workshop. Piano is available at the venue.
Participants will be asked to sing and play the instruments during the workshop.
For enquiries, please contact
airp@cuhk.edu.hk
.
About Jen Shyu:
https://www.jenshyu.com/
About the Programme:
https://www.arts.cuhk.edu.hk/web/cuhk-artist-in-residence

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:

【Earn HK$500 coupon】 Recruiting adults (aged 18-65) to participate in research on online therapy for insomnia 【可獲得 500元現金券】招募成年人 (18-65歲)參與失眠的數碼化治療研究 - Psychiatry
From: Charis
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
你是否經常在床上輾轉難眠，夜醒或早醒？你並不孤單——許多人都面臨著同樣的問題。我們誠邀您參與研究，讓專業數碼化治療助你改善睡眠！
研究目的
本研究旨在評估市民對數碼化失眠認知行為治療聊天機器人的遵從性，以及其對改善睡眠問題的效果。
治療方式
· 由專業臨床心理學家及精神科醫生設計的電子化治療
· 完全免費
參與資格
· 18至65歲能說廣東話流利溝通（能流利閱讀並理解廣東話）的香港居民
· 在過去一個月內，每週至少三晚出現睡眠困擾
· 最近四周或以上無需長期服藥
參與研究，獲得獎勵！
完成所有治療及後續測試後，您可獲得高達500港幣。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理聯絡。
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Do you often toss and turn in bed, wake up frequently at night, or wake up too early? You are not alone—many people experience the same challenges. We invite you to participate in our study and explore professional digital treatment to improve your sleep!
Purpose of the Study
This research aims to evaluate the public’s adherence to a digital insomnia cognitive behavioural therapy chatbot and assess its effectiveness in improving sleep problems.
Treatment Method
· A professionally designed digital therapy created by clinical psychologists and psychiatrists
· Completely free of charge
Eligibility Criteria
· Hong Kong residents aged 18 to 65 who can speak in Cantonese fluently, read and understand Cantonese
· Experienced sleep disturbances at least 3 nights per week in the past month
· No need for long-term medication for the past four weeks or more.
Receive Rewards for Participating!
Upon completion of all treatment sessions and follow-up assessments, participants will receive up to HKD 500.
How to Join?
Click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact suitable participants to provide further details:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4UPFh054GtJGXX0
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants.

Lecture Demonstration: Cantonese Contemporary Music

29 October 2026 (Thursday), 8:00 pm

Lee Hysan Concert Hall, The Chinese University of Hong Kong

Free admission with registration
Sign up:
https://forms.gle/iitUp9BKi3o6CaR69
The world-renowned
Mivos Quartet
will present works by faculty, students, and recent graduates of the CUHK Department of Music, written in response to the research theme
“Writing Contemporary Music in Cantonese: Practices and Potentialities”
. Each piece explores a range of approaches to composing with Cantonese text — from deriving pitched materials from tonal contours or psychoacoustic analyses of the language, to shaping musical structure through the narrative and poetic qualities of a text.
Before the performance, Prof. Kai-Young Chan will introduce(in Cantonese) the research project and the works featured in the demonstration, followed by a panel discussion (in English) in which the composers and the Mivos Quartet reflect together on contemporary music in Cantonese.
講座展演：粵語現代音樂

2026年10月29日（星期四）晚上8時

香港中文大學利希慎音樂廳

免費入場｜請先登記
報名連結：
https://forms.gle/iitUp9BKi3o6CaR69
這場音樂會由世界知名的
Mivos 四重奏
演繹香港中文大學音樂系師生及近期畢業生的作品，回應研究主題「粵語當代音樂創作：實踐與潛能」。各作品探索以粵語文本為素材進行創作的多種可能，例如從聲調輪廓或心理聲學分析啟發旋律寫作、以文本的敘事或詩意特質塑造音樂結構等。
演出前，陳啟揚教授將以粵語簡介研究計劃及各作品；演出後設英語專題座談，由作曲家與 Mivos 四重奏共同討論粵語當代音樂。

The world-renowned

Announcements
Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!!!] !!!注意: 男性特定群組 HPV 病毒篩查   [費用全免] [$400交通津貼] - Department of Surgery
From: Tim Lau
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
香港中文大學泌尿外科研究招募
:
香港中文大學泌尿外科現正進行一項男性特定群體的尿液及生物樣本HPV和病例對照研究。人類乳頭瘤病毒（HPV） 是全球最常見的性傳染病毒之一，能影響男性並導致多種疾病，包括生殖器疣（椰菜花）、陰莖癌、肛門癌 及 口咽癌。然而，男性 HPV 的感染情況一直缺乏研究，而你的參與將有助填補這個重要的知識空白。
本研究旨在了解HPV感染率、患者人口統計特徵、臨床特徵以及被診斷患有HPV相關惡性腫瘤的男性患者的疾病負擔。以評估男性尿液 HPV 測試的準確性，並更深入了解男性感染 HPV的風險因素，以及幫助未來預防及治療策略。
-如初步檢測確診為HPV陽性的患者，或將安排進一步行檢查 (例如:軟式膀胱鏡檢查等等)及跟進複檢。
參加者條件（男性，18歲或以上）：
1) 陰莖癌，肛⾨癌，或咽喉癌患者
2) 曾患性傳染病
3) 曾有同性性⾏為
(參加者太多, 其他組別優先)
4) 慢性前列腺炎患者
地點：沙⽥威爾斯親王醫院
樣本收集： 尿液及尿道拭子、口咽拭子、肛門拭子、冠狀溝拭子
-填寫簡單問卷
-根據情況也可能採集 20 毫升血液
[費用全免]
-完成整個研究計劃後可獲得港幣
$400
津貼
參加者的資料將會以專業方式絕對保密!!
所收集的資料僅用於學術研究用途
名額有限，先到先得!
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名：
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf__iQ0Ike8hpG6qIm1mjtF0nCTdcPFKT2v9jFARsuZbqjMJw/viewform?usp=header
-如果評估合適參與研究，將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如有查詢，歡迎電郵: timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk，與研究人員劉先生聯絡。
________________________________________________________________________
Free HPV Screening for Men in Specific Groups [Free!!]
The Chinese University of Hong Kong Division of Urology Research Recruitment
The Department of Surgery (Urology), The Chinese University of Hong Kong is currently recruiting participants for a hybrid cohort and case-control study on male urinary HPV.
Human Papillomavirus (HPV) is one of the most common sexually transmitted viruses worldwide. It can affect men and lead to serious conditions including genital warts, penile cancer, anal cancer, and oropharyngeal cancer. However, HPV infection in men remains under-studied. Your cooperation is highly solicited.
This research aims to determine HPV prevalence, patient demographics, clinical characteristics, and disease burden in men. It will also evaluate the accuracy of a new urine-based HPV DNA test and explore risk factors to support future prevention and treatment strategies.
Participants who test positive for HPV in the initial urine test may be invited for further investigations (e.g. flexible cystoscopy) and regular follow-up re-testing.
Eligibility (Males aged 18 or above)
Patients diagnosed with penile cancer, anal cancer, or oropharyngeal cancer
Men with a history of sexually transmitted diseases (STD)
Men who have sex with men (MSM)
[
As there are too many participants, other groups will take priority.
]
Patients with chronic prostatitis / chronic pelvic pain syndrome (CPPS)
Study Location: Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin
Narrative description
Urine sample + swabs (urethral, oropharyngeal, anal, coronal sulcus)
Complete a simple questionnaire
Optional: 20 ml blood sample (if required)
Free of Charge in HPV test !!
Upon successful completion of the study, participants will receive a
HKD 400
travel subsidy
Your Privacy is Fully Protected.
Data will only be used for academic research purposes.
If you are interested, please register via the link below:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf__iQ0Ike8hpG6qIm1mjtF0nCTdcPFKT2v9jFARsuZbqjMJw/viewform?usp=header
Suitable applicants will be contacted shortly.
For inquiries, please email:  timlau@surgery.cuhk.edu.hk

Announcements
<HK$300>Brain Health Study  <HK$300>中大醫學院邀您參與腦部健康研究 - CUHK Psychiatry Sleep Assessment Unit
From: Wong Yuen Tung
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yuentungwong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
便秘？嗅覺變差？睡覺拳打腳踢？有腦退化家族史？
這些看似平常的小毛病，其實可能是柏金遜症等大腦退化的早期先兆！
提早了解大腦健康，預防神經退化！
中大醫學院睡眠研究小組推出全新手機篩查App，誠邀您參與醫學研究！
研究對象：
年齡介乎
50 至 65 歲
的華人
未確診
任何腦神經退化疾病（如柏金遜症、阿爾茲海默症/失智症等）
參加者需完成以下程序：
參與研究
費用全免
，成功完成相關研究程序者最多可獲
HK$300元超市禮券
作為津貼
階段一：
下載手機程式並完成問卷 （約需 15–20 分鐘）
完成後可獲得早期柏金遜病風險分數
符合資格並完成問卷者可獲 HK$100元超市禮券
階段二：
部分參加者將獲邀進一步參與臨床評估
包括身體檢查、臨床訪談、居家睡眠測試及神經認知測試
符合資格並完成階段二者，可額外獲 HK$200元超市禮券
立刻掃描海報右下方
二維碼 (QR Code)
或
點擊連結
下載程式「柏健通」參與研究
IOS用戶：
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android用戶：
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
查詢（致電或WhatsApp）：3919 7792 / 5282 5786（研究助理 黃小姐）
Constipated？Weakened sense of smell？Acting out dream during sleep (punching and kicking) ？Having a family history of neurodegenerative disease？
Common issues like these can actually be early warning signs of brain degeneration, including neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson’s disease.
Understand your brain health early to prevent neurodegeneration.
Sleep Assessment Unit - Psychiatry, CUHK has launched a brand-new screening App, and we sincerely invite you to join our medical research study.
Target participants：
Chinese aged between 50 to 65 years old
Have NOT been diagnosed
with any neurodegenerative disease (e.g. Parkinson’s disease, Alzheimer’s disease/ Dementia, etc.)
What you will need to do:
Participation is completely free. Those who successfully complete the study procedure can receive up to HK$300 in supermarket voucher as an allowance.
Phase 1:
Download the mobile app "柏健通" and complete the questionnaires (take approximately 15-20 minutes)
An early Parkinson’s disease risk score will be provided upon completion
Eligible participants who complete the questionnaires will receive HK$100 supermarket voucher
Phase 2:
Selected participants will be invited to undergo further clinical assessments
Assessments include physical examination, clinical interviews, sleep studies, and neurocognitive assessments
Eligible participants who complete Phase 2 will receive an additional HK$200 supermarket voucher
Interested parties are welcome to participate by
clicking the links below
or
scanning the QR Code
in the poster to download the "柏健通" mobile application:
IOS users:
https://apps.apple.com/hk/app/%E6%9F%8F%E5%81%A5%E9%80%9A/id1626241589
Android users:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=edu.cuhk.parkinapp.v2
For details and registration enquiries, please contact our hotline: 39197792 or 5282 5786 (WhatsApp) (Research Assistant, Ms Wong)

The Master of Arts in Chinese Art History at The Chinese University of Hong Kong is the first master's programme in Hong Kong focusing on Chinese art history. It offers broad and robust academic training for students who inspires to explore the historical development of Chinese Art.
Grounded in both ancient and modern Chinese art, the programme adopts diverse Asian perspectives and guides students to understand critical Chinese art history topics across different periods. Students will also have opportunities to engage directly with art professionals and cultural institutions, gaining valuable insights into the latest developments in Chinese art across academia, museums, cultural heritage, and the creative industries.

課程以古今藝術為中心，並以多元的亞洲視角探討跨時代的藝術脈絡與相關研究。學生亦有機會與本地專業人士和藝術機構直接交流，掌握中國藝術在全球學術、文化產業等各個領域的發展趨勢，為未來投身學術、教育、文博、創意等產業奠下重要基礎。

‼【 $100 Token 】South Asian HK Permanent Residents (e.g., Indian, Pakistani) – Share your voice in a focus group and earn HKD$100 ‼【 $100 酬謝 】南亞裔香港永久居民（如印度、巴基斯坦裔）焦點小組訪談 – 分享您嘅故事，即獲$100酬謝 - School of Governance and Policy Science
From: MSSc in Global Political Economy, on behalf of Prof. Karim Bettache and LIN, Yu Hong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mgpeinfo@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
From: Research Team, School of Governance and Policy Science, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to WeChat: 13809899482 / WhatsApp: 69409544 / 1155220689@link.cuhk.edu.hk
**This study is supervised by Prof. Karim Bettache (email: karimbettache@cuhk.edu.hk)**
Dear Potential Participants,
We are a research team from the School of Governance and Policy Science at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. This study is funded by the Research Grants Council (RGC) and led by a leading scholar in political psychology. The findings are expected to be published in top-tier international journals.
We sincerely invite South Asian permanent residents of Hong Kong (e.g., Indian, Pakistani, Nepalese, Bangladeshi, Sri Lankan, etc.) to participate in a focus group interview on the long-term psychological impact of colonialism on post-colonial societies.
Target participants:
South Asian ethnicity (e.g., Indian, Pakistani, Nepalese, Bangladeshi, Sri Lankan, etc.)
Holders of Hong Kong Permanent Resident status
Able to communicate in Mandarin, Cantonese, or English
Procedures and details of this study:
Research Consent
Focus Group Interview: A group discussion led by professional researchers, lasting approximately 1.5 hours
Flexible Location: In-person at CUHK campus or online participation available
A $100 HKD token of appreciation will be provided upon completion. All personal information and discussion content will be kept strictly confidential and used for academic research purposes only.
Participation is voluntary, and your responses will be kept confidential.
If you are interested in participating, please contact us via:
WeChat: 13809899482
WhatsApp: 69409544
Email: 1155220689@link.cuhk.edu.hk
We will contact you afterwards to arrange further details.
For inquiries, please feel free to reach out through the above channels.
**本研究由Prof. Karim Bettache監督（電郵：karimbettache@cuhk.edu.hk)**
您好，我們是香港中文大學政務與政策科學學院的研究團隊。本研究由香港研究資助局（RGC）資助，PI為政治心理學領域泰斗級學者，最終成果擬發表於國際頂級期刊。
本研究團隊誠邀南亞裔香港永久居民參與一項焦點小組訪談，旨在探討殖民主義對前殖民地社會心理的長期影響。
研究對象：
南亞裔人士（如印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊爾、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡等裔）
持有香港永久居民身份
能以普通話 / 廣東話 / 英文進行溝通
以下為是次研究需要完成的事項：
簽署參加同意書
參與焦點小組訪談：在專業研究人員帶領下進行小組討論，時長約1.5小時
地點靈活：可選擇香港中文大學校內面談，或透過線上平台參與
完成研究後，參加者可獲得$100港幣酬謝。訪談內容將全程嚴格保密，所有個人信息及對話內容僅用於學術研究用途。
本研究屬自願參與性質，期間所取得的資料都會被嚴格保密。
如有意參與此項研究，歡迎透過以下方式聯絡我們：
微信：13809899482
WhatsApp：69409544
Email: 1155220689@link.cuhk.edu.hk
收到聯絡後，我們會再與合適參加者溝通後續安排。
如果對研究細節有任何疑問，歡迎透過上述方式與我們聯絡。
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

本研究團隊誠邀南亞裔香港永久居民參與一項焦點小組訪談，旨在探討殖民主義對前殖民地社會心理的長期影響。
研究對象：
南亞裔人士（如印度、巴基斯坦、尼泊爾、孟加拉、斯里蘭卡等裔）
持有香港永久居民身份
能以普通話 / 廣東話 / 英文進行溝通
以下為是次研究需要完成的事項：
簽署參加同意書
參與焦點小組訪談：在專業研究人員帶領下進行小組討論，時長約1.5小時
地點靈活：可選擇香港中文大學校內面談，或透過線上平台參與
完成研究後，參加者可獲得$100港幣酬謝。訪談內容將全程嚴格保密，所有個人信息及對話內容僅用於學術研究用途。
本研究屬自願參與性質，期間所取得的資料都會被嚴格保密。
如有意參與此項研究，歡迎透過以下方式聯絡我們：

收到聯絡後，我們會再與合適參加者溝通後續安排。

From: Yellow Wong

根據衛生署數據，前列腺癌是本港男性常見的癌症之一。透過及早篩查，可以有效降低相關的健康風險。本次活動由中大何善衡泌尿中心舉辦，為合資格人士提供免費的前列腺特異抗原 (PSA) 檢測服務。
活動地點： 沙田區（詳細地址將於成功報名後通知）
活動內容：(所需時間約一小時)
1. 影片講解：深入淺出地介紹前列腺增生及前列腺癌的檢查與治療知識。
2. 前列腺篩查：合資格人士可獲免費前列腺特異抗原（PSA）測試乙次.
• 測試方式：我們將以指尖採血方式為參加者抽取血液樣本，並透過PSA檢測機進行現場測試，約十分鐘即可得知結果。
參加資格：
• 性別：男性
• 年齡：50-75歲
• 從未接受前列腺相關檢查
如有興趣參加活動，請填妥以下表格。
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6

https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cance
r

According to data from the Department of Health, prostate cancer is one of the most common cancers among men in Hong Kong. Early screening can effectively reduce related health risks. This event is organized by the S.H. Ho Urology Centre of CUHK, providing free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) testing services for eligible individuals.
Event Venue: Shatin District (the exact address will be provided after successful registration)
Event Details: (Estimated duration: about one hour)
Video Presentation: An easy-to-understand introduction to the examination and treatment of prostate cancer and benign prostatic hyperplasia
Prostate Screening: Eligible participants will receive one free Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA) test.
Testing Method: We will collect blood samples from participants via a fingertip blood test and conduct an on-site PSA test using a PSA testing device. Results will be available in about ten minutes.
Eligibility:
Gender: Male
Age: 50-75 years old
Have never undergone any prostate-related examination
If you are interested in participating, please fill in the online form below;
https://forms.office.com/r/HRJspBWSW6
For more information about the assessment of prostate cancer risk, please visit the following website:
https://urologycentre.com.hk/zh-hant/diseases/detail/how-to-investigate-and-make-diagnosis-for-prostate-cancer
All information provided by participants will be kept confidential. For any enquiries, please contact us (WhatsApp: 5160 6904; Email: yellowwong@cuhk.edu.hk)

From: Catherine So

wingchee@cuhk.edu.hk

Dear Colleagues and Students,
You are invited to attend an upcoming Research Grants Council (RGC) Public Lecture on
Saturday, 17 October 2026
, where Professor Catherine So will be sharing her latest research in autism intervention and family support.
Lecture Details:
Topic:
All-round Autism Care: An Overarching Intervention Approach for Autistic Children and Their Parents
Speaker:
Prof. Catherine Wing-chee So (Department of Educational Psychology, CUHK)
Date:
Saturday, 17 October 2026
Time:
3:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (HKT)
Venue:
Lecture Theatre, Hong Kong Central Library
Live Broadcast:
Language:
Cantonese
Admission:
Free (first-come, first-served)
In this session, Professor So will present key findings from our team’s signature
RABI® intervention model
. She will also discuss how integrating technology-assisted training with comprehensive
parent support
delivers meaningful social, educational, and emotional benefits for autistic children and their families.
We would be honored to have you join us—either in person at the Central Library or via the live stream ((
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJUipdvSACZjO1ldoO3YQBA
).
Please feel free to forward this invitation to any interested members of your team.

bodyText:

“Urban Forestry and Public Humanities in Hong Kong”  - Centre for Cultural Studies
From: Miss Manuela Wong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
manuelawong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
“Urban Forestry and Public Humanities in Hong Kong” is an immersive, hands-on program designed for CUHK students to explore the vital role trees play in cooling our streets, cleaning our air, and boosting community well-being. Led by scholars, experts, and artists, you will gain knowledge about our trees and the role they play in our urban and rural environment and ecosystem. You will also learn to develop an aesthetic relationship with our trees by watching them, listening to them, and capturing them in artistic ways. Whether you like trees or community building, you will leave with the tools and knowledge needed to promote urban nature.
Registration is open to all full-time CUHK students, with a quota of 20. Those participants who have completed all activities will be offered a Certificate of Participation – Workshop in Urban Forestry.
Schedule:
OCT 16 (12:00–5:00 PM) — Briefing, Lectures & Tree Walk
LATE OCT to MID NOV — Hands-on Workshops (Small-group)
MID NOV — Exhibition
Registration:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741899
Speakers:

Jimmy Ho (CRS, CUHK)

1.Priority will be given to students of BA in Public Humanities, Cultural Studies and Cultural Management Programme.
2.Places are limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served basis.

Announcements
~[Research Invitation] Speech Intervention Study for Cantonese-speaking Children and Adolescents with Cleft Palate 【研究邀請】招募參與「唇顎裂兒童及青少年語音介入」之學術研究 - Department of Otorhinolarynogology, Head and Neck Surgery
From: Rina To
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
rinato@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
各位香港中文大學成員：
我們誠邀閣下及其子女參與由香港中文大學耳鼻喉科、頭頸外科進行的學術研究 。
研究題目： 「探索針對唇顎裂兒童及青少年的語音介入框架：隨機對照試驗」
研究目的：患有唇顎裂的兒童有較高風險出現語音/發音困難，這可能嚴重影響其說話清晰度。本研究旨在比較兩種不同的實證語音介入框架（線性與非線性語音介入）在改善這些語音錯誤方面的成效。
招募對象：
說廣東話的兒童及青少年 (4歲 – 17歲)；
4 至 17 歲，母語為廣東話嘅兒童及青少年。
患有唇顎裂，並有發音/語音問題。
於 24 個月大前已完成唇顎裂之修復手術；
無已知認知障礙，或任何會影響其獨立參與語音任務能力的醫療狀況。
研究程序：
全面評估：參與者將經歷全面的語音評估程序，包括多項標準化語音測試及填寫問卷。
個別治療：參與者將接受由專業言語治療師設計的語音治療方案。請注意，候補名單對照組的參與者將在主要研究觀察階段結束後接受治療。
錄影記錄：參與者的語音將被錄影，以作進一步記錄和分析。所有語音數據及錄音將受密碼保護並嚴格保密 。
費用與報酬：
潛在益處：參與者能透過治療方案提升整體說話清晰度，並為唇顎裂語音的臨床護理程序及機制提供貢獻。
參與費用：參與本研究無需支付任何額外費用。
聯絡方式： 如有興趣參與或有任何疑問，請致電 3943 9609 聯絡首席研究員 何皓賢先生。
感謝閣下對本研究計劃的興趣與支持。亦可以使用以下連結報名:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13736537
此研究項目已獲香港中文大學 – 新界東醫院聯網臨床研究倫理聯席委員會（Joint CUHK-NTEC-CREC）批准。
Dear Members of the CUHK Community,
We are cordially inviting children and adolescents with Cleft Palate ± Lip to participate in a research study conducted by the Division of Speech Therapy (Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery) at The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Study Title: Exploring Speech Intervention Frameworks for Cantonese-speaking Children and Adolescents with Cleft Palate +/- Lip: A Randomized-Controlled Trial.
Children born with Cleft Palate ±Lip (CP±L) are at high risk for speech difficulties, such as glottal stops or backing errors, which can significantly impact how well they produce speech sounds and are understood. This study investigates the effectiveness of two different evidence-based speech intervention frameworks (Linear vs. Non-linear phonological intervention) in improving these speech outcomes.
Who Can Participate?
Cantonese-speaking children and adolescents (aged 4 to 17) with CP±L
Individuals exhibiting cleft speech errors that require intervention;
Primary repair of the palate done prior to 24 months old;
No known cognitive or hearing impairment, or other medical conditions that prevent independent participation in speech tasks.
What is Involved?
Comprehensive Assessment: Participants will undergo standardized speech assessments and questionnaires.
Treatment: Participants will receive speech therapy protocols designed by professional speech therapists. Please note that participants in the waitlist group will receive treatment after the primary study observation phase.
Recording: Speech sessions will be video-recorded for data analysis and will remain strictly confidential.
Benefits and Costs:
Potential Benefits: Improvement in overall speech clarity and contribution to the clinical management of cleft palate speech.
Costs: There is no additional cost to participate.
Contact Information: If you are interested or have questions, please contact Mr. Choco Ho (何皓賢), Speech Therapist and Principal Investigator, at 3943 9609 or click the link below:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13736537
This study has been approved by the Joint CUHK-NTEC-CREC.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

/weekly/

2026-2027 Voluntary User-Pay Dental Service Scheme (VUPDSS)
Voluntary User-Pay Dental Service Scheme (VUPDSS) is a voluntary and self-paid dental service between the University’s members and the service providers, Health & Care Dental Services Limited and Quality HealthCare Dental Services Limited. Its primary purpose is to provide participants the additional convenience of receiving dental service at contracted dental clinics outside campus at concessionary rate. Full-time students, full-time staff and dependents, eligible retirees and dependents can enroll in the Scheme. The Scheme is open for application. Membership is valid from 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027.
Details of the Scheme is available at:
https://www.umso.cuhk.edu.hk/form-download/
2026-2027 自費牙科服務計劃
「自費牙科服務計劃」為一個自願性付費形式的牙齒保健計劃。 合資格大學成員可參加由恒健牙科服務有限公司及卓健牙科服務有限公司所提供的牙科保健服務。 本計劃旨在為參加者提供一個具彈性及享有優惠價格之牙科服務。 全日制學生、全職職員及家屬、合資格退休員工及家屬均可參加。 計劃現正接受申請，會籍有效期由2026年9月1日至2027年8月31日。
計劃詳情，請瀏覽網頁:

Announcements
We need you!! AI+Music!! Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research 一齊聽歌! 招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究 - Department of Psychiatry
From: Xiuyang Meng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
招募音樂愛好青年｜人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究
我們正在尋找熱愛音樂的你，參與人工智能與流行歌曲情緒分類研究，用你的聽感為 AI 模型注入真實的青年情緒視角。
研究目的
本研究旨在運用人工智能技術，從青年視角對粵語流行歌曲進行情緒分類標註，評估青年群體對音樂情緒的主觀感知特徵，並為個性化音樂推薦系統及情緒調節相關研究提供數據支持。
招募條件
8 至 24 歲，熱愛音樂且經常聆聽流行音樂，能流暢使用粵語及英語進行溝通與表達的青年。
參與內容
聆聽 50 首粵語流行歌曲，並完整聽畢每首參與標註的曲目，依據自身主觀體驗與即時情緒感受，將歌曲進行情緒分類。
如何加入？
請點擊以下連結進行註冊，並回答幾條簡單問題。研究員將聯絡適合的參加者，詳細解釋研究內容：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
聯絡我們
如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理陳小姐 或 蒙先生聯絡。
Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research
We are looking for music lovers like you to participate in our research on AI and popular song emotion categorization, contributing your listening experience to inject authentic youth emotional perspectives into our AI model.
Purpose of the Study
This study aims to use artificial intelligence technology to annotate the emotion categories of Cantopop songs from a youth perspective, evaluate the subjective emotional perception characteristics of young people towards music, and provide data support for personalized music recommendation systems and emotion regulation-related research.
Eligibility Criteria
Young people aged 18 to 24 who love music, listen to popular music regularly, and are able to communicate fluently in Cantonese and English.
Participation Content
Listen to 50 Cantopop songs in full and categorize each song according to your subjective experience and immediate emotional feelings.
How to Join?
Please click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact eligible participants to explain the study details in full:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants Ms. Chan or Mr. Meng.

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

如有任何疑問，請於辦公時間內致電 6115-0322 與研究助理陳小姐 或 蒙先生聯絡。
Recruiting Young Music Lovers | AI and Popular Song Emotion Categorization Research
We are looking for music lovers like you to participate in our research on AI and popular song emotion categorization, contributing your listening experience to inject authentic youth emotional perspectives into our AI model.
Purpose of the Study
This study aims to use artificial intelligence technology to annotate the emotion categories of Cantopop songs from a youth perspective, evaluate the subjective emotional perception characteristics of young people towards music, and provide data support for personalized music recommendation systems and emotion regulation-related research.
Eligibility Criteria
Young people aged 18 to 24 who love music, listen to popular music regularly, and are able to communicate fluently in Cantonese and English.
Participation Content
Listen to 50 Cantopop songs in full and categorize each song according to your subjective experience and immediate emotional feelings.
How to Join?
Please click the link below to register and answer a few simple questions. Our researchers will contact eligible participants to explain the study details in full:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_5pU67FrIxYilalw
Contact Us
If you have any questions, please call 6115-0322 during office hours to speak with our research assistants Ms. Chan or Mr. Meng.
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

年齡介乎 50 至 80 歲

沒有腦退化、精神疾病史

填寫問卷 及 進行簡單面談
進行一次非入侵性睡眠檢測
記錄連續兩星期「大便日記」
進行一次結腸運輸試驗
收集一次大便樣本

Effects of mindfulness-based training on the microbiome of older adults with chronic stress: A randomised controlled trial
現正誠邀合資格人士報名參加
We are now recruiting participants to join our programme.
賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院 現誠邀60歲以上人士參加一項靜觀課程研究
研究將會探討靜觀課程對有慢性壓力的長者的微生物群的影響。
很多長者受慢性壓力困擾，如未能適當處理壓力，對他們的心理及生理皆有嚴重影響。研究發現慢性壓力會破壞腸道微生物群的平衡。靜觀證實可有效改善心理健康，卻甚少研究探究靜觀課程如何改善參與者的微生物群。這項研究將在社區招募138名年滿60歲人士，邀請他們參與為長者而設的靜觀課程與健康教育控制課程，比較兩者於改善壓力、負面情緒及腸道微生物的成效。
參加者將會被隨機分派入兩組其中一組：
a) 靜觀練習組：
分派入本組的參加者將接受為期八周，每週一次，每次大約一小時三十分鐘的靜觀課程。每堂靜課程將會錄音，以作審視課程的保真度。
b) 健康教育組：
分派入本組的參加者會接受為期八周，每週一次，每次大約一小時三十分鐘的健康教育課程，課程內容包括營養，運動，維持生活習慣。每堂靜課程將會錄音，以作審視課程的保真度。
招募對象:
i) 年齡60歲以上;
ii) 能聽講廣東話;
iii) 需要持續照顧有長期病患的親屬;
iv) 照顧者負荷指數達 7分或以上;
v)沒有經醫生診斷有精神病患或認知問題;
vi) 沒有嚴重的身體或精神問題;
vi)不是正接受心理治療;
vii) 兩年內沒有參加過正規的靜觀課程;
viii) 被照顧親屬並非剛離世;
ix) 三個月內沒有使用抗生素或益生菌
課堂詳情
時間：10月尾開始 星期三或四的 上午
地點：沙田瀝源健康院 - 本活動共8節, 每週1次, 每次1.5小時
兩組參加者均須在課程開始前、結束後，及結束後3個月填寫共次3問卷調查及提供3次糞便樣本。
*費用全免*
參與是次研究不需繳付任何費用。
每次提供樣本及填寫問卷將會獲得價值$100 的現金卷，最高可獲300元現金卷。

bodyText:

The Characteristics of "Humanistic" Application in Venerable Master Hsing Yun’s Lyric Creations 星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質 - Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism
From: 人間佛教研究中心 Centre for the Study of Humanistic Buddhism
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
cshb@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
星雲大師歌詞創作的「人間」應用特質
時間：11月19日 | 週四 14:30 - 16:30
講者：林仁昱教授 | 中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741303
演講簡介：
星雲大師在倡議與實踐「人間佛教」的道路上，不僅以歌曲來推廣理念，許多歌曲也成為導引新時代儀節與活動的重要部分。從1950年代作〈西方〉以取代念佛共修的傳統迴向四句偈，作〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉來適應建立「佛化家庭」的重要典儀；1970年代作〈三寶頌〉濃縮歷代各種〈三皈依〉偈讚歌詞要義，更方便傳唱應用；到2000年以後，創作眾多「人間音緣」歌詞，廣徵作曲，使相同歌詞可有不同風格的譜曲，靈活運用於各種弘法與社會活動，充分表現「人間」應用的特質。本次講座將順著時代脈絡，剖析歌詞內涵與實際應用情形，論述其具體意義及影響力。
On his path of advocating and practicing "Humanistic Buddhism," Venerable Master Hsing Yun not only promoted Buddhist concepts through songs, but many of his musical works also became essential components guiding rituals and activities in the modern era.
Historically, this practical approach unfolded across several key stages: In the 1950s, he composed Western Land (〈西方〉) to replace the traditional four-line verse for the dedication of merit during collective chanting cultivation, and penned the Blessing Song for Buddhist Weddings (〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉) to accommodate the pivotal rituals of establishing "Buddhist Families." In the 1970s, he authored the Ode to the Triple Gem (〈三寶頌〉), which condensed the essential meanings of various historical verses praising the Three Refuges into a format more accessible for singing and collective use. From 2000 onward, he created numerous lyrics for Sounds of the Human World (「人間音緣」) and openly solicited musical compositions, allowing the same lyrics to be adapted into diverse musical styles and flexibly utilized in various Dharma propagation and social events. This approach fully exemplifies the characteristics of "humanistic" and practical application.
Following a chronological framework, this lecture will analyze the inner connotations and practical applications of these lyrics, discussing their concrete significance and far-reaching influence.
嘉賓簡介：
林仁昱，中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任，以佛教文學與文化、敦煌文獻與文學、歌謠俗曲與風俗為研究領域，重要著作有：《敦煌佛教歌曲之研究》、《廿世紀初中國俗曲唱述人物》、《敦煌佛教讚歌寫本「原生態」與應用研究》，近期刊登於期刊的單篇著作有：〈星雲大師1950－70年代佛教歌詞創作探究〉、〈星雲大師「人間音緣」歌詞的文學表現及其效應〉、〈《觀音十二圓覺》的菩薩化身與度化對象探究〉、〈觀音與地藏組合供奉的信仰意義與衍發現象〉、〈現代東亞佛誕節文藝與文化考察—以臺灣、日本、馬來西亞為探究核心〉等。

星雲大師在倡議與實踐「人間佛教」的道路上，不僅以歌曲來推廣理念，許多歌曲也成為導引新時代儀節與活動的重要部分。從1950年代作〈西方〉以取代念佛共修的傳統迴向四句偈，作〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉來適應建立「佛化家庭」的重要典儀；1970年代作〈三寶頌〉濃縮歷代各種〈三皈依〉偈讚歌詞要義，更方便傳唱應用；到2000年以後，創作眾多「人間音緣」歌詞，廣徵作曲，使相同歌詞可有不同風格的譜曲，靈活運用於各種弘法與社會活動，充分表現「人間」應用的特質。本次講座將順著時代脈絡，剖析歌詞內涵與實際應用情形，論述其具體意義及影響力。
On his path of advocating and practicing "Humanistic Buddhism," Venerable Master Hsing Yun not only promoted Buddhist concepts through songs, but many of his musical works also became essential components guiding rituals and activities in the modern era.
Historically, this practical approach unfolded across several key stages: In the 1950s, he composed Western Land (〈西方〉) to replace the traditional four-line verse for the dedication of merit during collective chanting cultivation, and penned the Blessing Song for Buddhist Weddings (〈佛化婚禮祝歌〉) to accommodate the pivotal rituals of establishing "Buddhist Families." In the 1970s, he authored the Ode to the Triple Gem (〈三寶頌〉), which condensed the essential meanings of various historical verses praising the Three Refuges into a format more accessible for singing and collective use. From 2000 onward, he created numerous lyrics for Sounds of the Human World (「人間音緣」) and openly solicited musical compositions, allowing the same lyrics to be adapted into diverse musical styles and flexibly utilized in various Dharma propagation and social events. This approach fully exemplifies the characteristics of "humanistic" and practical application.
Following a chronological framework, this lecture will analyze the inner connotations and practical applications of these lyrics, discussing their concrete significance and far-reaching influence.
嘉賓簡介：
林仁昱，中興大學中文系特聘教授兼藝術中心主任，以佛教文學與文化、敦煌文獻與文學、歌謠俗曲與風俗為研究領域，重要著作有：《敦煌佛教歌曲之研究》、《廿世紀初中國俗曲唱述人物》、《敦煌佛教讚歌寫本「原生態」與應用研究》，近期刊登於期刊的單篇著作有：〈星雲大師1950－70年代佛教歌詞創作探究〉、〈星雲大師「人間音緣」歌詞的文學表現及其效應〉、〈《觀音十二圓覺》的菩薩化身與度化對象探究〉、〈觀音與地藏組合供奉的信仰意義與衍發現象〉、〈現代東亞佛誕節文藝與文化考察—以臺灣、日本、馬來西亞為探究核心〉等。

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
人間佛教的新博物館學實踐:星雲大師的博物館情懷
時間：11月4日 | 週三 10:00 - 12:00
講者：張譽騰教授 | 國立台南藝術大學博物館學研究所兼任教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：現場講座 & ZOOM網絡會議
地點：香港中文大學馮景禧樓 & 會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741301
演講簡介：
「人間佛教」主張佛法不離世間，強調將佛法落實在日常生活，服務社會，讓佛教從山林走入社會，此正與新博物館學訴求遙相呼應。星雲大師是宗教開創者，但很少人知道他在博物館方面也建樹良多，疊有新意。本講座將從三個面向探討大師在新博物館學的成就:
一、從生態博物館角度說明整座佛光山其實就是一座無牆博物館。
二、從博物館與科技、社區和永續三個層次，說明佛陀紀念館成立迄今，如何與時俱進，踐行新博物館學理念。
三、從佛光山核心館與衛星館發展策略談佛光緣美術館群如何與在地道場結合，將佛光山能量有效輻射出去。
"Humanistic Buddhism" advocates that the Buddha-Dharma is not separate from the world, emphasizing the implementation of Buddhist teachings in daily life, serving society, and guiding Buddhism from isolated mountains into secular society. This philosophy echoes the core pursuits of "New Museology."
While Venerable Master Hsing Yun is widely recognized as a religious pioneer, few are aware of his profound achievements and innovative ideas in the field of museum studies.This presentation will explore the Master’s achievements in New Museology through three main dimensions:
1. The Ecomuseum Perspective: Illustrating how the entirety of Fo Guang Shan functions as a "Museum without Walls."
2. Technology, Community, and Sustainability: Examining how the Fo Guang Shan Buddha Museum has kept pace with the times since its inception, putting the principles of New Museology into practice.
3. Core and Satellite Museum Development Strategy: Discussing how the Fo Guang Yuan Art Galleries integrate with local Buddhist centers (dojos) to effectively radiate Fo Guang Shan's energy outward.
嘉賓簡介：
張譽騰教授，畢業於國立台灣大學動物學系，1992年獲得英國萊斯特大學(University of Leicester)博物館學博士。曾任國立台南藝術大學博物館學研究所教授和文博學院院長、行政院文化建設委員會政務副主委、國立歷史博物館館長、中華民國博物館學會理事長、佛光大學講座教授。主要學術著作有: 《當代博物館探索》、《博物館大勢觀察》、《生態博物館:一個文化運動的興起》。現為國立台南藝術大學博物館學研究所兼任教授，並擔任佛光山顧問與學術委員會委員。

為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
太虛大師的世界佛教運動與文明論述：1920年代為中心
時間：10月27日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：龔雋教授 | 中山大學哲學系教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
ZOOM ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741299
演講簡介：
本次講座立足於思想史的視野與方法，對太虛在1920年代的世界佛教運動及其文明論述進行詳密的討論與分析。分別從三個方面來開展論述。首先，把太虛的東西文明論放置在1920年代中國思想界有關東西文明與文化論爭這一脈絡中來加以審查，以深入理解太虛相關論述的思想史處境。其次，討論太虛歐美布教中的文明論論述，特別闡釋他是如何「格義」佛教與西方的科學、哲學而另立新說。最後，對太虛佛教世界化的文明論述進行評論，闡析其論述背後複雜的思想面向，特別是他的文明論述中所隱含的東方主義及其民族主義觀念。
Grounded in the perspectives and methodologies of intellectual history, this lecture provides a detailed discussion and analysis of Master Taixu’s World Buddhist Movement and his discourse on civilization during the 1920s.
The presentation unfolds across three primary dimensions:First, it situates Master Taixu’s views on Eastern and Western civilizations within the context of the 1920s Chinese intellectual debates surrounding Eastern versus Western civilization and culture, thereby deepening our understanding of the intellectual milieu of his discourse.
Second, it examines Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse during his missionary travels in Europe and America, specifically elucidating how he utilized Geyi (conceptual matching) to interface Buddhism with Western science and philosophy to forge his innovative theories.
Finally, the lecture reflects critically on Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse regarding the globalization of Buddhism, analyzing the complex intellectual dimensions underlying his arguments—particularly the implicit notions of Orientalism and nationalism embedded within his discourse on civilization.
嘉賓簡介：
龔雋教授，現任中山大學哲學系教授、中華外國哲學史學會東方哲學專業委員會副主任、中國社科院評價研究院宗教專業委員會委員，並擔任《新史學》、《漢語佛學評論》、《人文宗教研究》等多種學術刊物編委。主要從事中國佛教思想的教學與研究，代表性著作包括《作為「知識」的近代佛學史論——在東亞視域內的知識史論述》（商務印書館，2019，合著）、《中國禪學研究入門》（復旦大學出版社，2009，合著）及《禪史鉤沉：以問題為中心的思想史論述》（北京三聯書店，2006）。另於海內外學術刊物發表論文四十餘篇。

本次講座立足於思想史的視野與方法，對太虛在1920年代的世界佛教運動及其文明論述進行詳密的討論與分析。分別從三個方面來開展論述。首先，把太虛的東西文明論放置在1920年代中國思想界有關東西文明與文化論爭這一脈絡中來加以審查，以深入理解太虛相關論述的思想史處境。其次，討論太虛歐美布教中的文明論論述，特別闡釋他是如何「格義」佛教與西方的科學、哲學而另立新說。最後，對太虛佛教世界化的文明論述進行評論，闡析其論述背後複雜的思想面向，特別是他的文明論述中所隱含的東方主義及其民族主義觀念。
Grounded in the perspectives and methodologies of intellectual history, this lecture provides a detailed discussion and analysis of Master Taixu’s World Buddhist Movement and his discourse on civilization during the 1920s.
The presentation unfolds across three primary dimensions:First, it situates Master Taixu’s views on Eastern and Western civilizations within the context of the 1920s Chinese intellectual debates surrounding Eastern versus Western civilization and culture, thereby deepening our understanding of the intellectual milieu of his discourse.
Second, it examines Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse during his missionary travels in Europe and America, specifically elucidating how he utilized Geyi (conceptual matching) to interface Buddhism with Western science and philosophy to forge his innovative theories.
Finally, the lecture reflects critically on Master Taixu’s civilizational discourse regarding the globalization of Buddhism, analyzing the complex intellectual dimensions underlying his arguments—particularly the implicit notions of Orientalism and nationalism embedded within his discourse on civilization.

龔雋教授，現任中山大學哲學系教授、中華外國哲學史學會東方哲學專業委員會副主任、中國社科院評價研究院宗教專業委員會委員，並擔任《新史學》、《漢語佛學評論》、《人文宗教研究》等多種學術刊物編委。主要從事中國佛教思想的教學與研究，代表性著作包括《作為「知識」的近代佛學史論——在東亞視域內的知識史論述》（商務印書館，2019，合著）、《中國禪學研究入門》（復旦大學出版社，2009，合著）及《禪史鉤沉：以問題為中心的思想史論述》（北京三聯書店，2006）。另於海內外學術刊物發表論文四十餘篇。

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
從生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的關係看人間佛教
時間：10月20日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：唐忠毛教授 | 華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：ZOOM網絡會議
會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741297
演講簡介：
生活邏輯立足世俗現實，講求日常責任、人倫倫理，以現世生活價值及時代說變遷為導向，佛教信仰邏輯依託佛教義理，以緣起性空、因果解脫、菩薩利他為終極追求，具備出世超越性。人間佛教的核心，就是以中道的立場調和二者的對立割裂，實現入世生活與出世信仰的辯證統一。星雲大師糾正了傳統佛教理解上的兩種偏差：一是偏重信仰邏輯、消極出世，將修行等同於遠離俗世、逃避現實責任，否定現世生活的修行；二是被生活邏輯裹挾，信仰徹底世俗功利化。人間佛教秉持中道立場，主張佛法不離世間覺。一方面，以生活邏輯為信仰的根基，修行不脫離日常起居、家庭倫理與社會事務，強調在人間踐行善行、擔當責任，把世俗生活作為修行道場，認可現世人生的改造價值。另一方面，以信仰邏輯引領淨化世俗生活，秉持“以出世精神做入世事業”，用慈悲、無我、緣起智慧破除世間功利執著，把日常生活昇華為自利利他的菩薩行。要言之，人間佛教不脫離世間、不執著世間，以世俗生活承載信仰實踐，以終極信仰安頓現實人生，完成了生活邏輯與信仰邏輯的融合統一，也適配當代的社會理念。
The "logic of life" is grounded in secular reality, emphasizing daily responsibilities and human ethics, guided by the values of worldly life and temporal changes. Conversely, the "logic of Buddhist faith" relies on Buddhist doctrines, with the ultimate pursuit of dependent origination, emptiness of nature, karmic cause and effect, liberation, and Bodhisattva altruism, possessing a transcendent and world-transcending nature. The core of Humanistic Buddhism lies in using a Middle Way stance to reconcile the opposition and fragmentation between the two, achieving a dialectical unity of world-engaging life and world-transcending faith.
Venerable Master Hsing Yun corrected two deviations in the traditional understanding of Buddhism: first, an overemphasis on the logic of faith leading to passive world-transcendence, equating spiritual cultivation with escaping secular life and evading realistic responsibilities; second, being overwhelmed by the logic of life, leading to the complete secularization and utilitarianism of faith. Humanistic Buddhism upholds the Middle Way stance, asserting that the Buddha-Dharma is not separate from worldly awakening.
On one hand, it treats the logic of life as the foundation of faith, where spiritual practice is intertwined with daily routines, family ethics, and social affairs, emphasizing the practice of wholesome deeds and taking on responsibilities in the human world, thereby transforming secular life into a place of spiritual cultivation (dojo). On the other hand, it guides and purifies secular life through the logic of faith, adhering to the principle of "engaging in worldly enterprises with a world-transcending spirit," using compassion, selflessness, and the wisdom of dependent origination to eradicate worldly and utilitarian attachments. In short, Humanistic Buddhism neither detaches from nor clings to the world; it uses secular life to carry out faith practices and uses ultimate faith to settle reality-based life, completing the integration and unity of the logic of life and the logic of faith, while adapting to contemporary social philosophies.
嘉賓簡介：
唐忠毛教授，哲學博士、歷史學博士後。現任華東師範大學社會發展學院教授、博士生導師，華東師範大學區域文化資源與應用研究中心主任、華東師範大學宗教與社會研究中心副主任。兼任中國宗教學會理事、上海市宗教學會副會長。研究領域集中於佛教學、信仰民俗學、區域文化學等。出版專著多本發表論文多篇，代表論著有《佛教本覺思想論爭的現代性考察》（2006）《中國佛教近代轉型的社會之維——民間上海居士佛教篇組織與慈善研究》（2013）《從空性到體用——中國佛教心性本體論的建構與反思》（2019）等。主持國家社科基金重點、一般等項目多項，參與重大專案多項。近年來完成的國家社科基金項目成果包括《佛教中國化的民間民俗向度研究》《江南“廟-鎮”信仰空間與地方社會研究》等。

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
行腳足跡與寫作字迹：星雲大師的文學考察
時間：10月6日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：李瑞騰教授 | 中央大學中文系榮譽教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：現場講座 & ZOOM網絡會議
地點：香港中文大學馮景禧樓 & 會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741745
演講簡介：
星雲大師日夜俯首為文；視力衰退以後改以口述，出口成章，成就了豐碩的《星雲大師全集》。其中的「文學」，除第五類「文叢」，尚有第六類「傳記」、第七類「日記」、第八類「書信」，。以文類來說，有詩、散文（含雜文、日記、書信等）、報導文學、傳記、小說等，另口述部分，將以「口述」界定之。這些「字迹」（文字之迹）對應他全球行腳「足跡」，才是圓滿的星雲大師，星雲文學考察的重要性，於焉可見。
Day and night, Venerable Master Hsing Yun dedicated himself to writing. In his later years, as his eyesight declined, he shifted to dictation, with his spoken words effortlessly flowing into eloquent chapters, culminating in the monumental The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun. The "literature" within The Complete Works extends beyond the fifth category, "Literary Collections," to encompass the sixth category ("Biographies"), the seventh category ("Diaries"), and the eighth category ("Letters"). In terms of literary genres, it spans poetry, prose (including essays, diaries, and letters), reportage, biography, and fiction, alongside sections defined specifically as "oral literature." These "ink-trails" (the traces of his written words) closely correspond to the "footsteps" of his global travels; only through both do we perceive the complete picture of Venerable Master Hsing Yun. From this, the profound importance of conducting a literary examination of his works becomes fully evident.
嘉賓簡介：
李瑞騰教授，曾任中央大學中文系教授兼系主任、圖書館館長、文學院院長、臺灣文學館館長等。現為中央大學中文系榮譽教授，並擔任全球華文文學星雲獎評議委員會主任委員、佛光山佛陀紀念館學術發展委員會主任委員。著有文學論著《臺灣文學風貌》、《文學關懷》、《文學的出路》、《新詩學》、《詩心與詩史》、《砂拉越華文文學的價值》等，及散文集《有風就要停》、《像我這樣得教授》、詩集《在中央》、《阿疼說》等。

為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
行腳足跡與寫作字迹：星雲大師的文學考察
時間：10月6日 | 週二 14:30 - 16:30
講者：李瑞騰教授 | 中央大學中文系榮譽教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：現場講座 & ZOOM網絡會議
地點：香港中文大學馮景禧樓 & 會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741745
演講簡介：
星雲大師日夜俯首為文；視力衰退以後改以口述，出口成章，成就了豐碩的《星雲大師全集》。其中的「文學」，除第五類「文叢」，尚有第六類「傳記」、第七類「日記」、第八類「書信」，。以文類來說，有詩、散文（含雜文、日記、書信等）、報導文學、傳記、小說等，另口述部分，將以「口述」界定之。這些「字迹」（文字之迹）對應他全球行腳「足跡」，才是圓滿的星雲大師，星雲文學考察的重要性，於焉可見。
Day and night, Venerable Master Hsing Yun dedicated himself to writing. In his later years, as his eyesight declined, he shifted to dictation, with his spoken words effortlessly flowing into eloquent chapters, culminating in the monumental The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun. The "literature" within The Complete Works extends beyond the fifth category, "Literary Collections," to encompass the sixth category ("Biographies"), the seventh category ("Diaries"), and the eighth category ("Letters"). In terms of literary genres, it spans poetry, prose (including essays, diaries, and letters), reportage, biography, and fiction, alongside sections defined specifically as "oral literature." These "ink-trails" (the traces of his written words) closely correspond to the "footsteps" of his global travels; only through both do we perceive the complete picture of Venerable Master Hsing Yun. From this, the profound importance of conducting a literary examination of his works becomes fully evident.
嘉賓簡介：
李瑞騰教授，曾任中央大學中文系教授兼系主任、圖書館館長、文學院院長、臺灣文學館館長等。現為中央大學中文系榮譽教授，並擔任全球華文文學星雲獎評議委員會主任委員、佛光山佛陀紀念館學術發展委員會主任委員。著有文學論著《臺灣文學風貌》、《文學關懷》、《文學的出路》、《新詩學》、《詩心與詩史》、《砂拉越華文文學的價值》等，及散文集《有風就要停》、《像我這樣得教授》、詩集《在中央》、《阿疼說》等。

題目：
《人間福報》與星雲大師人間佛教的實踐
時間：10月6日 | 週二 10：00 - 12：00
講者：楊錦郁博士 | 美國花藝設計學院（AFAS）教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任

報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741295
演講簡介：
星雲大師一生以文字和語言弘揚佛法，從平面媒體用到電子媒體，跨域跨國，法水長流五大洲。2000年，他創辦《人間福報》，我那時任職聯合報副刊，奉報社之命專訪星雲大師談辦報緣起，文刊創刊當日聯副。其後兼《人間福報》藝文組主任，應聘擔任《人間福報》總監，於大師人間佛教的思想理念及其實踐，多所體會。此其間並長期為副刊撰寫專欄，結集5本散文專書。
Throughout his life, Venerable Master Hsing Yun propagated the Dharma through both the written and spoken word, utilizing mediums ranging from print to electronic media. His efforts crossed boundaries and transnational lines, spreading the water of the Dharma across five continents. In 2000, the Master founded The Merit Times. At that time, while working for the literary supplement of the United Daily News, I was commissioned by the newspaper to interview Venerable Master Hsing Yun regarding his vision for establishing the paper. The interview was published in the United Daily News literary supplement on the very day of The Merit Times’ inaugural issue. Later, I concurrently served as the Director of the Arts and Literature Section and was invited to become the Managing Director of The Merit Times, which granted me profound insights into the conceptual framework and practical application of the Master's Humanistic Buddhism. During this period, I also contributed long-running columns to the literary supplement, which were eventually compiled into five distinct prose volumes.
嘉賓簡介：
楊錦郁博士，散文家、媒體人，淡江大學中文系博士，美國花藝設計學院（AFAS）教授，曾任職聯合報副刊組、人間福報總監。著有多部人物報導集及散文集《遠方有光》、《穿過一樹的夜光》、《好時光》、《小西巷》、《霧中恆河》、《花希望成為自己的樣子》，論著《呂碧城文學與思想》等。曾獲中興文藝獎章、中山文藝創作獎，磺溪文學獎特別貢獻獎。

題目：

時間：10月5日 | 週一 14:30 - 16:30
講者：李瑞騰教授 | 中央大學中文系榮譽教授
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任

演講簡介：
星雲大師於1949年春率僧侶救護隊來臺，先到臺南，然後北上臺中、臺北，流離奔波，無處掛單，後落腳於中壢圓光寺，展開他在臺灣最初的艱困歲月，期間曾被逮捕拘禁，蒙難23天；曾赴苗栗法雲寺看守山林、到新竹靈隱寺協助臺灣青年佛教講習會，並開始執筆為文，參與佛教刊物的編輯工作，積累下一個階段在宜蘭弘法的文化資本。處境艱難，青年星雲法師如何肆應？
In the spring of 1949, Venerable Master Hsing Yun arrived in Taiwan leading the Buddhist Sangha Rescue Team. He initially traveled to Tainan, and later ventured north to Taichung and Taipei. Displaced, wandering, and finding no monastic shelter to lodge, he eventually settled at Yuanuang Temple in Zhongli, marking the beginning of his initial grueling years in Taiwan. During this turbulent period, he was arrested and detained, enduring 23 days of imprisonment.Later, he went to Fayun Temple in Miaoli to guard the mountain forests, and subsequently assisted with the Taiwan Youth Buddhist Seminar at Lingyin Temple in Hsinchu. It was also during this time that he began writing and participating in the editing of Buddhist periodicals, accumulation the cultural capital required for his next stage of Dharma propagation in Yilan. Given such severe and perilous circumstances, how did the young Venerable Master Hsing Yun adapt and respond?

星雲大師於1949年春率僧侶救護隊來臺，先到臺南，然後北上臺中、臺北，流離奔波，無處掛單，後落腳於中壢圓光寺，展開他在臺灣最初的艱困歲月，期間曾被逮捕拘禁，蒙難23天；曾赴苗栗法雲寺看守山林、到新竹靈隱寺協助臺灣青年佛教講習會，並開始執筆為文，參與佛教刊物的編輯工作，積累下一個階段在宜蘭弘法的文化資本。處境艱難，青年星雲法師如何肆應？
In the spring of 1949, Venerable Master Hsing Yun arrived in Taiwan leading the Buddhist Sangha Rescue Team. He initially traveled to Tainan, and later ventured north to Taichung and Taipei. Displaced, wandering, and finding no monastic shelter to lodge, he eventually settled at Yuanuang Temple in Zhongli, marking the beginning of his initial grueling years in Taiwan. During this turbulent period, he was arrested and detained, enduring 23 days of imprisonment.Later, he went to Fayun Temple in Miaoli to guard the mountain forests, and subsequently assisted with the Taiwan Youth Buddhist Seminar at Lingyin Temple in Hsinchu. It was also during this time that he began writing and participating in the editing of Buddhist periodicals, accumulation the cultural capital required for his next stage of Dharma propagation in Yilan. Given such severe and perilous circumstances, how did the young Venerable Master Hsing Yun adapt and respond?
嘉賓簡介：
李瑞騰教授，曾任中央大學中文系教授兼系主任、圖書館館長、文學院院長、臺灣文學館館長等。現為中央大學中文系榮譽教授，並擔任全球華文文學星雲獎評議委員會主任委員、佛光山佛陀紀念館學術發展委員會主任委員。著有文學論著《臺灣文學風貌》、《文學關懷》、《文學的出路》、《新詩學》、《詩心與詩史》、《砂拉越華文文學的價值》等，及散文集《有風就要停》、《像我這樣得教授》、詩集《在中央》、《阿疼說》等。

【精彩上線｜紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰系列講座】
為紀念星雲大師百歲誕辰，香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心與佛學研究中心聯合舉辦 「人間佛教的文本、行跡與時代開展」 系列講座。我們特別邀請了宗教學、文學、哲學、出版、媒體與博物館學等領域的頂尖專家學者，帶來 9 場重磅專題演講！內容橫跨跨跨文化對話、文學考察、媒體實踐到新博物館學，從多元視角深化對星雲大師思想的理解。本次系列講座全面開放線上參與，歡迎大眾踴躍共霑法益。
題目：
編者的凝視：從《星雲大師全集》看大師的寫作身影與文學世界
時間：10月5日 | 週一 10:00 - 12:00
講者：蔡孟樺院長 | 佛光山人間佛教研究院副院長
主持：陳劍鍠教授 | 香港中文大學人間佛教研究中心主任
形式：現場講座 & ZOOM網絡會議
地點：香港中文大學馮景禧樓 & 會議ID: 964 5779 7423，密碼: 999999
報名：https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741074
演講簡介：
《星雲大師全集》高達395冊、逾四千萬字，不僅是當代人間佛教的百科全書，更是研究星雲大師文學世界最核心的文獻寶庫。本講座由《全集》主編的視角開啟，跳脫傳統學術理論的論述，從最微觀、最前線的編纂實務出發，希望與聽者一起重返大師創作的歷史現場，進入大師創作的初衷。在搜集與校勘過程中，編者得以穿梭時空，「近距離」凝視大師從青年詩歌小說到晚年口述隨筆的寫作身影。講座將分享親侍大師的微觀體感，透過筆觸細節讀出文字背後的呼吸與慈悲神情，為人間佛教文學研究開闢溫暖而深邃的新視野。
Spanning 395 volumes and over 40 million words, The Complete Works of Venerable Master Hsing Yun serves not only as a contemporary encyclopedia of Humanistic Buddhism but also as the most critical archival treasure trove for studying the Master's literary world. Opening from the unique perspective of the Editor-in-Chief of The Complete Works, this lecture moves beyond traditional academic theories. Instead, it begins with the most micro-level and frontline practices of compilation, inviting the audience to return to the historical scenes of the Master’s creations and enter his original intent. Through the processes of collection and collation, the editor was able to traverse time and space, observing the Master’s writing style "at close range"—from his youthful poetry and novels to his oral dictations and essays in his later years. This lecture will share the speaker's personal experience of closely serving the Master. By examining subtle details in his writing, the lecture reads the breath and compassionate expressions behind the words, opening up a warm and profound new horizon for the study of Humanistic Buddhism literature.
嘉賓簡介：
蔡孟樺，資深佛教出版人，現任佛光山人間佛教研究院副院長、《人間佛教學報．藝文》主編。13歲皈依星雲大師，佛光山叢林學院畢業並於佛光大學文學研究所進修。歷任佛光山法堂書記、《人間福報》副刊主編與香海文化執行長，編輯出版大師著作百餘本，並主編《百年佛緣》、《獻給旅行者365日》、《人間佛教佛陀本懷》等。2016年銜師命擔綱《星雲大師全集》主編。長期致力於人間佛教思想的傳播與出版。
