From: Dr. WONG Wing Ho, Oscar
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hatch@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
家長您好，我們是香港中文大學醫學院精神科學系的研究團隊。本研究由香港中文大學醫學院精神科學系、內科及藥物治療學系統籌。
本研究團隊誠邀3歲以下兒童參與一項有關腸道微生態與兒童大腦發展及風險研究。此研究希望透過收集小朋友之大便及口腔樣本，幫助了解腸道微生態與大腦發展的關係。
研究對象:
1) 確診/懷疑小朋友有自閉症傾向或其他發展問題
2) 33個月或以下的小朋友 (交齊問卷和樣本的日子未滿3歲即可)
3) 父母皆為華裔或亞裔人士
4) 小朋友18歲以下的兄弟姊妹
以下為是次研究需要完成的事項：
1) 簽署參加同意書
2) 網上問卷調查：網上問卷主要詢問小朋友的行為及腸道情況，填寫時間約45分鐘
3) 收集大便和口腔樣本：我們會給家長一個樣本收集包，請家長使用收集包內的物在家中資協助收集樣本
4) 飲食習慣的問卷：記錄小朋友的飲食習慣
完成研究後，參加者可以獲得$200的超市現金券、 G-NiiB益生菌試用裝和腸道健康報告作為答謝 另外，家長有機會被邀請進行面談並隨訪2年,如有需要我們會提供轉介信。是次研究是自願參與性質參與，這個研究期間所取得的資料都會被嚴格保密。
如家長有意願參與此項研究，請填寫以下網上篩選問卷(https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_81kdBVoLu4f6l3o)。收到問卷回覆後，我們會再與合適參加是次研究的小朋友之家長連絡。
如果家長對研究細節有任何疑問，歡迎透過WhatsApp 6099-3064或致電 2607-6057與我們聯絡。
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Dear Parents,
We are a team of researchers from the Department of Psychiatry at the Chinese University of Hong Kong. We are conducting a research project jointly organised by the Department of Psychiatry, the Department of Medicine and Therapeutics of the Chinese University of Hong Kong.
Our team sincerely invites your children to participate in research on the gut microbiome and children's brain development. Through collecting stool and buccal samples, we aim to investigate the relationship between the gut microbiome and brain development.
A gut health report will be provided, A G-Niib probiotics trial pack and a $200 supermarket voucher will be awarded to participants.
Target participants:
1) The child is diagnosed/suspected to have autism or other developmental problems
2) The child is under 33 months old (all questionnaires and samples are submitted before 3 years old)
3) Both parents are Chinese or Asian
4) Children’s brothers and sisters under 18 years old are also welcome to join
Procedures and details of this Study:
1) Research Consent
2) Online Questionnaire : A 45-minute questionnaire on children’s behaviors and their physical health condition
3) Stool and Buccal Sample Collection: Samples collection kit will be provided for sample collection at home
4) Dietary Questionnaire: Recording children's eating habits
You will receive a $200 supermarket voucher after completing all the research procedures. Participation is voluntary, and your responses will be kept confidential. The information you provide will be used solely for research purposes.
If you are interested in participating in our research study, please fill out the following online questionnaire (https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_81kdBVoLu4f6l3o). We will contact you afterwards if your children are suitable to join this study.
For inquiries, please contact 2607-6057 or WhatsApp 6099-3064.

Communication Seminar Series - From AI Adoption to AI Agency: How Artificial Intelligence Is Reshaping Communication Work
Date: 15 October 2026 (Thursday)
Time: 2:30 pm-4:00 pm
Venue: C-Centre (NAH313, Humanities Building, CUHK)
Speaker:
Prof. Sung-Un Yang
Professor
Department of Mass Communication, Advertising, and Public Relations
Boston University, USA
Bio:
Sung-Un Yang (PhD, University of Maryland, 2005) is the Harold Burson Endowed Chair in Public Relations and Department Chair of Mass Communication, Advertising, and Public Relations at Boston University. His recent research focuses on strategic communication management, with particular emphasis on how emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, reshape public-organization relationships, employee communication, and organizational change. His recent work examines how communication professionals adopt AI and how leadership, internal communication, and organizational readiness drive successful integration.
Abstract:
Artificial intelligence is reshaping communication management at technological, organizational, and professional levels. This seminar presents three interconnected studies examining that transformation. The first investigates how perceived innovation attributes and AI-related threats influence communication professionals’ adoption attitudes and workplace AI use. The second examines how transformational leadership, dialogic communication, commitment to change, and organizational AI readiness shape employee responses to AI-driven change. The third introduces ongoing research on agentic AI, focusing on how increasingly autonomous systems may affect role ambiguity, professional authorship, job meaningfulness, and AI-related stress. Together, the studies trace the evolution from adopting AI tools to managing organizational change and confronting the consequences of delegating professional agency to AI systems.
Language: English

  [Online experiment] Looking for native English speakers
Prof. Haerim Hwang (Department of English, CUHK) is looking for participants for a study on language production.
Which participants are we looking for?
- English is your first/native and dominant language
- Your graduate degree is not in the field of linguistics
- Can use your laptop/computer and have access to stable internet (no smartphones, laptops, or hotspot)
- Can participate in an experiment on Zoom in a quiet environment
- Have Chrome on your laptop/computer
How do I participate?
1. Fill out this questionnaire
-- English speakers: https://forms.gle/ttuhGGCwRx2n95kBA
2. Our research team will reach out to you, confirming your availability.
3. It will take approximately 2 hours to complete these tasks.
What do I get out of the study?
You will get HK$250 in cash upon the completion of the task.
Your participation will enhance our understanding of how people process English sentences.
Questions?
Contact Prof. Haerim Hwang at haerimhwang@cuhk.edu.hk

The Chinese University of Hong Kong Survey and Behavioural Research Ethics Committee SBREC (fssc02@cuhk.edu.hk) has vetted the study (Approval ID: SBRE-22-0026D). If you have any concerns regarding ethics, please contact them.

(The application below is conducted in Chinese only.)
日期：2026年10月16日（星期五）
時間：下午12時半至2時
地點：香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓4樓401室
語言：廣東話
講者：丁新豹教授（香港中文大學歷史系客席教授(禮任)）
免費登記：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13740761
講座簡介：
丁新豹教授，香港歷史學者，香港大學中文系哲學博士，現任香港中文大學歷史系客席教授（禮任）、比較及公眾歷史研究中心名譽高級研究員、香港大學中文學院名譽教授、廣東省文史館館員，以及香港與內地多間博物館的名譽顧問或理事。曾任香港歷史博物館總館長。
講者簡介：
回顧丁新豹教授半個世紀的習史過程可區分為：修讀碩士、博士時期；任職藝術館／博物館時期及退休後通過實地考察學習歷史共三個階段。第一個階段主要從文獻入手，從拓跋族遷徙漢化到香港開埠初期華人社會的形成並落地生根，兩者看似風馬牛不相及，而實有某些共通點。第二個階段利用文物研究歷史：在藝術館九年以歷史畫探研珠三角的昔日風貌，而在香港歷史博物館近二十年，因策劃香港故事常設展、海防博物館及孫中山紀念館，開啟了嶄新的研究範疇，擴闊視野；另方面，通過舉辦多個主題不一的專題展覽，有機會涉獵到國史以外的歷史，甚或可以和國史相互參證。退休後，除初期從事東華三院歷史研究外，主要圍繞：東南亞華僑史、絲綢之路及東亞文化圈（日本、韓國、越南）三個主題通過實地考察探究歷史，獲益良多。從求學、工作、消閒，丁教授在人生旅途的不同階段以不同方式習史，不變的是無比的興趣和一顆好奇心。

日期：2026年10月16日（星期五）

地點：香港中文大學利黃瑤璧樓4樓401室
語言：廣東話
講者：丁新豹教授（香港中文大學歷史系客席教授(禮任)）
免費登記：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13740761
講座簡介：
丁新豹教授，香港歷史學者，香港大學中文系哲學博士，現任香港中文大學歷史系客席教授（禮任）、比較及公眾歷史研究中心名譽高級研究員、香港大學中文學院名譽教授、廣東省文史館館員，以及香港與內地多間博物館的名譽顧問或理事。曾任香港歷史博物館總館長。
講者簡介：
回顧丁新豹教授半個世紀的習史過程可區分為：修讀碩士、博士時期；任職藝術館／博物館時期及退休後通過實地考察學習歷史共三個階段。第一個階段主要從文獻入手，從拓跋族遷徙漢化到香港開埠初期華人社會的形成並落地生根，兩者看似風馬牛不相及，而實有某些共通點。第二個階段利用文物研究歷史：在藝術館九年以歷史畫探研珠三角的昔日風貌，而在香港歷史博物館近二十年，因策劃香港故事常設展、海防博物館及孫中山紀念館，開啟了嶄新的研究範疇，擴闊視野；另方面，通過舉辦多個主題不一的專題展覽，有機會涉獵到國史以外的歷史，甚或可以和國史相互參證。退休後，除初期從事東華三院歷史研究外，主要圍繞：東南亞華僑史、絲綢之路及東亞文化圈（日本、韓國、越南）三個主題通過實地考察探究歷史，獲益良多。從求學、工作、消閒，丁教授在人生旅途的不同階段以不同方式習史，不變的是無比的興趣和一顆好奇心。

From: Maggie Lee

[
新中藥方劑治療
2
型糖尿病的臨床安全性、有效性和多組評價：對
β
細胞功能和胰島素抵抗的影響】
香港中文大學內科及藥物治療學系與香港中文大學香港中西醫結合醫學研究所現正聯合進行一項為期36週，以內服中藥(沖劑)治療 2 型糖尿病人
 研究對象：18至80歲華人
沒有重大疾病，沒有服用中藥， 身體質量指數 (BMI) ≥18 kg/m²  (公斤 ÷ 米 ÷ 米)
不吸煙或已戒煙至少 12 個月，如女性目前未懷孕
患糖尿病未滿 6 年，且在過去 3 個月內未使用任何降血糖藥物（包括胰島素）治療
至少具備以下其中一項風險因素:
糖尿病家族史 (尤其父母或兄弟姐妹在40歲前診斷 )
代謝綜合症 (3高：高血糖，高血壓，高膽固醇)
超重或肥胖
脂肪肝
多囊卵巢綜合症
妊娠糖尿病病史
如不確定自己是否患有糖尿病，會安排你服用葡萄糖飲料（75 克口服葡萄糖耐量試驗）
研究內容：中西醫評估、心電圖、肝纖維化掃描、抽血檢查、填寫問卷、服用研究中藥或安慰劑等
地點：新界沙田威爾斯醫院，舊座，3 樓，3M 病房 - 糖尿及內分泌研究中心
參與研究費用全免，成功參與者可獲得高達港幣 $1,000 的津貼，名額有限，先到先得！
閣下如對本研究有興趣請透過以下連結報名參加：
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692
如果初步合適參與研究，負責同事將稍後聯絡你，謝謝
如對研究內容有任何疑問，歡迎致電  3505 3897 / 6937 3365 或 WhatsApp 6937 3365與負責研究人員聯絡、查詢詳情。
[Clinical safety, efficacy and multiomic evaluation of a novel Chinese Medicine formula in Type 2 diabetes: Effects on beta-cell function and insulin resistance
.]
Department of Medicine and Therapeutics and Hong Kong Institute of Integrative Medicine, CUHK are jointly conducting a 36-week clinical study on the use of oral traditional Chinese medicine (granule form) for treating type 2 diabetes.
Eligibility Criteria: Ethnic Chinese individuals aged 18 to 80 years
No major illnesses, not currently taking any traditional Chinese medicine, and with a Body Mass Index (BMI) ≥ 18 kg/m² (kg ÷ metre ÷ metre)
Non-smokers or those who have quit smoking for at least 12 months; females must not be currently pregnant
Diagnosed with type 2 diabetes for less than 6 years and have not used any glucose-lowering medications (including insulin) in the past 3 months
Must have at least one of the following risk factors:
Family history of diabetes (especially if parents or siblings were diagnosed before age of 40)
Metabolic syndrome (three highs: high blood sugar, high blood pressure, high blood cholesterol)
Overweight or obesity
Fatty liver
Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS)
History of gestational diabetes
If you are unsure whether you have diabetes, a 75g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT) will be arranged for you.

Study Procedures Include:
Chinese and Western medical assessments, Electrocardiogram (ECG), Liver fibrosis scan, Blood tests, Questionnaire completion, Taking either the study Chinese medicine or a placebo
Location: Ward 3M, 3/F, Old Block, Diabetes and Endocrinology Research Centre, Prince of Wales Hospital, Sha Tin, New Territories
Free of charge to participate.
Successful participants may receive an allowance of up to HKD $1,000.
Limited quota – first come, first served!
Register via the following link:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/mycuform/view.php?id=3542692
If you are eligible based on initial assessment, our research team will contact you shortly. Thank you!
For inquiries, please contact:
3505 3897 / 6937 3365
WhatsApp: 6937 3365

誠邀閣下與子女參與一項關於華語兒童中英數能力的跨學科大型研究，詳情如下：
對象：
幼稚園高班至六年級單生兒和雙胞胎學生（包括同卵雙生和異卵雙生）
學童家長
學童需以廣東話為母語，並在香港居住 2.5 年以上
目的：
建立學童在中、英文讀寫和數學能力發展的多模態模型，以及設計能夠全面反映兒童在這三方面表現的網上測試工具
研究內容：
第一部分
學童：中英文和數學能力的測試
，分成網上測試和面對面測試兩部分。網上測試分為六個區域，各需時約40分鐘。網上測試毋須一次完成，參加者可自行安排時間分段執行，在四星期內完成所有項目即可。
面對面測試在網上測試完成後另約時間進行，約需45分鐘
家長：
在網上測試平台接受
約
15
分鐘的語文及數學測試
，及填寫關於學童學習情況與家庭語言環境的
問卷
*
現在報名的幼稚園高班至六年級學童只需完成今年一次測試
第二部分（可選擇是否參與）
學童：腦電圖測試（EEG），約2小時
報酬：今年測試完結後將收到：
(1) 測試結果的個人報告；(2) 港幣200元超級市場現金券；(3) 小禮物，
參與腦電圖 (EEG) 部份的學生另有250元超級市場現金券
研究詳情及報名請見以下網頁：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4OWk4Rmnmb0M20e
如對是項研究有任何疑問或查詢，歡迎聯絡本項目的首席研究員Urs Maurer教授（電郵: umaurer@cuhk.edu.hk）或研究小組（電話：3943-4379；電郵：
lifespandevlab.cuhk@gmail.com
）。
We are recruiting for a multi-disciplinary study about the Chinese, English, and Mathematical abilities among Chinese-speaking children in Hong Kong. Details are as below:
Target participants:
Singletons and twins (both identical and fraternal) from K3 to P6 in the 2025/26 school year
Students’ parents
The child participant must be a native Cantonese speaker and have lived in Hong Kong for more than 2.5 years.
Content:
Part 1
Students
: A series of assessments on Chinese, English, and mathematics on the project’s online testing platform. The tasks are divided into six portions; each takes about 40 minutes to finish. Online testing can be completed at your own pace, as long as all tasks are completed within 4 weeks.
A follow-up face-to-face session (45 minutes) will be arranged upon completion of the online testing.
Parents
: Short online testing on language and mathematics abilities (15 minutes), as well as a set of questionnaires on children’s learning and home language environment
*For current registration
s, students from K3 to P6 only need to complete the test once this year.
Part 2 (optional)
Students: electroencephalography (EEG) test (~2 hour)
Rewards: After each round of testing, participants will receive:
(1) Personal performance report; (2) $200 supermarket vouchers; (3) a gift (for students); EEG participants will receive an additional $250 worth of supermarket vouchers
The details of the study and the registration form can be found in the following link:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_4OWk4Rmnmb0M20e
Should you have any enquiries, please contact Prof. Urs Maurer, the principle investigator (umaurer@cuhk.edu.hk) or the research team (3943-4379 or lifespandevlab.cuhk@gmail.com).

Announcements
Call for Applications: NTU AI-for-X Postdoctoral Fellowship 2026 (Deadline: 30 October)  - Office of Academic Links
From: Office of Academic Links
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
oal_schemes@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore, is now inviting applications for the
NTU AI-for-X Postdoctoral Fellowship 2026
. The application period is open until
30 October 2026
.
About the Fellowship
Launched in partnership with Singapore's National Research Foundation (NRF), this prestigious fellowship supports outstanding early-career researchers who seek to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) to accelerate scientific discovery across science, technology, engineering, mathematics, and medicine (STEM). The programme aims to nurture the next generation of interdisciplinary research leaders working at the intersection of AI and scientific research. More information is available
here
.
Fellowship Highlights
Up to 4 years of funding
Competitive remuneration and benefits
SGD 250,000 research grant with continued funding even after transition to a tenure-track role
Access to NTU's AI platforms, research facilities, and computing resources
Structured AI training and mentorship from NTU faculty across AI and STEM disciplines
Eligibility
Applicants should:
Hold a PhD (or equivalent) awarded in 2023 or later in a STEM discipline
Have a strong academic and research track record
Propose a research project that integrates AI to address a scientific challenge
Identify an NTU faculty member as a Project Mentor
Available to commence the fellowship by 31 March 2027
Each selected Fellow will be paired with:
A
Project Mentor
in their research field
An
AI Mentor
(assigned or selected post-award) to support AI integration
Application Information
Application Deadline
: 30 October 2026, 2359 hrs (Singapore Time, UTC/GMT+8)
Application Portal
: Applications must be submitted in electronic format via NTU Online Application
Portal
.
Further Information
:
NTU AI-for-X Postdoctoral Fellowship

Registration

10:00 – 11:00 AM
Register

Register
The briefing sessions will provide prospective applicants with more information about the fellowship and application process.

.

Unlock Your Potential: Join the CUHK eLearning Student Ambassadors 2026/2027! Registration is NOW open for all CUHK (UG & PG) students  - Information Technology Services Centre (ITSC)
From: Rudi C. (ITSC)
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
rudichow@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Are you someone who has a strong interest in communication, digital media, publication, information technology, AI trends, and online learning?
Would you like to develop your own multimedia and online portfolio while assisting other fellow students to have a better online learning experience?
If the answer is YES, we would like to invite you to apply and join us to become a
CUHK eLearning Student Ambassador (eLSA)
.
We are seeking applicants (Year 1 - 4 UG students, and all PG students) who are:
Driven to perform a
creative
and
dynamic
role to help fellow students in utilising various eLearning resources (including AI trends and its application in education).
Committed
and
motivated
to learn and improve IT, AI tools, online media, and digital skills to support their studies and future careers.
eLSA programme offers you:
An opportunity to develop digital, media production, IT, communication, organisation and teamwork skills.
Regular trainings that cover the fundamental IT and digital production skills you would need to support the work.
An opportunity to create and showcase your digital and online portfolio. (including CUHK SDP - Student Development Portfolio programme)
A space to contribute innovative ideas and exercise creative thinking to improve the CUHK eLearning environment.
eLSA ambassadors will receive subsidies under the
University’s Campus Work Scheme
.
Please complete the webform at:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741495

From: Rudi C. (ITSC)
rudichow@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Are you someone who has a strong interest in communication, digital media, publication, information technology, AI trends, and online learning?
Would you like to develop your own multimedia and online portfolio while assisting other fellow students to have a better online learning experience?
If the answer is YES, we would like to invite you to apply and join us to become a
CUHK eLearning Student Ambassador (eLSA)
.
We are seeking applicants (Year 1 - 4 UG students, and all PG students) who are:
Driven to perform a
creative
and
dynamic
role to help fellow students in utilising various eLearning resources (including AI trends and its application in education).
Committed
and
motivated
to learn and improve IT, AI tools, online media, and digital skills to support their studies and future careers.
eLSA programme offers you:
An opportunity to develop digital, media production, IT, communication, organisation and teamwork skills.
Regular trainings that cover the fundamental IT and digital production skills you would need to support the work.
An opportunity to create and showcase your digital and online portfolio. (including CUHK SDP - Student Development Portfolio programme)
A space to contribute innovative ideas and exercise creative thinking to improve the CUHK eLearning environment.
eLSA ambassadors will receive subsidies under the
University’s Campus Work Scheme
.
Please complete the webform at:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13741495
Application deadline
(extended)
: October 3, 2026 - 11.59 PM.
To learn more about eLearning@CUHK, please visit
https://www.cuhk.edu.hk/eLearning
.

rudichow@cuhk.edu.hk

From: Lam Sui Chi
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
chaplaincy@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
報名崇基學院第七十五屆校慶學生節「崇慶環校跑」
Registration for the “Founders' Day Round Campus Run” of The 75th Chung Chi College Founders' Day Student Festival
(Please scroll down for English version)
各位同學、教職員及校友：
為慶祝崇基學院七十五週年校慶，崇基學院將舉辦一年一度的「崇慶環校跑」，這項盛事不僅是體能與毅力的挑戰，更是凝聚校園精神、促進交流的絕佳機會。歡迎崇基學院以及香港中文大學其它書院的本科生、教職員及校友參加。不論您是運動健將還是跑步愛好者，都歡迎一同揮灑青春汗水，共慶崇基生辰！
活動詳情
日期：
2026年10月30日（星期五）
時間：
登記：下午2時00分 至 2時40分
儀式及比賽：下午2時45分 至4時
地點：
崇基學院嶺南運動場（起點與終點）
組別：
個人賽
男子組
女子組
參賽者：
崇基學院以及香港中文大學其它書院的本科生、教職員及校友均可參加，惟獎項只頒發給崇基學院學生、教職員及校友。
獎項：
冠、亞、季軍各一名（男、女子組分開計算）
初擬路線：
嶺南運動場 > 崇基學院行政樓 > 何添樓 > 崇基教堂 > 何善衡工程大樓 > 蒙民偉工程大樓 > 善衡書院 > 夏鼎基運動場 > 方潤華堂 > 嶺南運動場
備註：
參賽者必須於下午2時40分前到報到處登記並取號碼布，否則將被取消參賽資格；
學生參賽者必須於賽事登記時以學生證拍卡登記，並在完成賽事後重新拍卡以登記完成賽事，否則將不獲4分體育課程活動分；
參賽者必須於限時四十五分鐘內完成賽事；
參賽者必須以個人名義參賽；
參賽者（包括教職員和校友）將分為男子組及女子組進行比賽；
參賽者必須戴上號碼布及按照大會指定路線進行比賽；
參賽者在比賽期間不可阻礙其他參賽者前進及使用輔助工具；
如有投訴，參賽者必須在終點站關閉後十分鐘內向司令台負責人提出，逾時將不獲受理；
參賽者必須遵守以上規則，違規者將有機會被取消參賽資格；
參賽者必須注意個人安全及看管個人財物；
賽事將以名次決定勝出者，男、女子組分別最快完成賽事的參賽者為第一名，即個人賽的冠軍，如此類推（男、女子組分開計算，即男、女子組各有名次）。
雨程：
若活動當天中午12時正仍下雨，比賽將會取消。活動消息將在週會末段的宣傳時間公布，同時在眾志堂和嶺南場門外貼出通告，並透過電郵通知參賽者相關消息，敬請留意電郵；
若在報到或比賽期間下雨，大會將視乎雨勢及賽道情況而終止賽事。惟參賽者必須於下午2時40分前報到，並於本學期內把號碼布交還給體育部老師，方可獲4分體育課程活動分。
期待在跑道上見到你的身影，一起為校慶增添喜慶！請於
2026
年
10
月
16
日（星期五）或之前
於
CC75RoundCampusRun
報名。成功報名之參賽者將於10月23日（星期五）或之前收到確認電郵。
如有查詢，請與崇基學院校牧室Walter聯絡（電話：3943 4301或電郵至
walterlam@cuhk.edu.hk
）。
“Founders' Day Round Campus Run” of The 75th Chung Chi College Founders' Day Student Festival
Dear Students, Staff Members and Alumni,
In celebration of the Chung Chi College 75th Anniversary, the annual “Founders' Day Round Campus Run” will be held on October 30, 2026. This event is not only a challenge of physical strength and perseverance but also a wonderful opportunity to strengthen campus spirit and foster connections among students, faculty, and alumni. Students, staff members, and alumni from Chung Chi College and other colleges of The Chinese University of Hong Kong are all warmly welcome to join. Whether you are an athlete or a running enthusiast, come along to sweat it out and celebrate Chung Chi’s birthday together!
Details
Date:
October 30, 2026（Friday）
Time:
Registration: 2:00 p.m. to 2:40 p.m.
Ceremony & Competition: 2:45 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Venue:
Lingnan Stadium of Chung Chi College (Start and Finish points)
Division:
Individuals
Men
Women
Participant:
Students, staff members, and alumni from Chung Chi College and other colleges of The Chinese University of Hong Kong are welcome to join, but only those from Chung Chi College are eligible to receive prizes.
Award:
Champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up will be awarded in both the Men’s and Women’s divisions.
Initial Route:
Lingnan Stadium > CCC Admin Building > Ho Tim Building > CC Chapel > Ho Sin-Hang Engineering Building > William MW Mong Engineering Building > S.H. Ho College > Sir Philip Haddon-Cave Sports Field > Fong Yun Wah Hall > Lingnan Stadium
Remarks:
Runners must check in at the registration counter and collect race bib no later than 2:40 p.m. Late registration will lead to disqualification.
Student runners must tap their student ID card at registration and tap again upon completion of the race. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of the 4 participation marks in P.E. course.
Runners must complete the race within the 45-minute time limit.
All runners must compete as individuals.
Runners (including staff and alumni) will be divided into Men’s and Women’s divisions.
Runners must wear their assigned bib number and follow the designated route throughout the race.
Runners must not obstruct other runners or use any form of assistance during the race.
Any complaints must be lodged with the officials at the command desk within 10 minutes after the closing of the finish line. Late complaints will not be entertained.
Runners must adhere to all rules above. Violations may lead to disqualification.
Runners are responsible for their personal safety and belongings.
Winners will be determined by finishing order. The fastest finisher in the Men’s and Women’s divisions respectively will be awarded 1st place, followed by 2nd and 3rd places. Rankings are calculated separately for each division.
Rain Plan:
If it rains until 12:00 p.m. on the day of the event, the race will be cancelled. Notifications will be made via email, announced at the end of the Friday Assembly, and posted at the entrance of the Chung Chi Tang and Lingnan Stadium.
If it rains after the event has started, the organizer reserves the right to cancel it based on safety conditions. Regardless of cancellation, runners must check in by 2:40 p.m. and return their bibs to the PE Unit within the semester to receive 4 participation marks in P.E. course.
Interested participants should register for the Round Campus Run at
CC75RoundCampusRun
by October 16, 2026 (Friday)
. Participants who successfully register will receive a confirmation email by October 23 (Friday).
For enquiries, please contact Mr. Walter Lam from the Chaplain’s Office of Chung Chi College at 3943 4301 or via email at
waltelam@cuhk.edu.hk
.

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

冠、亞、季軍各一名（男、女子組分開計算）
初擬路線：
嶺南運動場 > 崇基學院行政樓 > 何添樓 > 崇基教堂 > 何善衡工程大樓 > 蒙民偉工程大樓 > 善衡書院 > 夏鼎基運動場 > 方潤華堂 > 嶺南運動場
備註：
參賽者必須於下午2時40分前到報到處登記並取號碼布，否則將被取消參賽資格；
學生參賽者必須於賽事登記時以學生證拍卡登記，並在完成賽事後重新拍卡以登記完成賽事，否則將不獲4分體育課程活動分；
參賽者必須於限時四十五分鐘內完成賽事；
參賽者必須以個人名義參賽；
參賽者（包括教職員和校友）將分為男子組及女子組進行比賽；
參賽者必須戴上號碼布及按照大會指定路線進行比賽；
參賽者在比賽期間不可阻礙其他參賽者前進及使用輔助工具；
如有投訴，參賽者必須在終點站關閉後十分鐘內向司令台負責人提出，逾時將不獲受理；
參賽者必須遵守以上規則，違規者將有機會被取消參賽資格；
參賽者必須注意個人安全及看管個人財物；
賽事將以名次決定勝出者，男、女子組分別最快完成賽事的參賽者為第一名，即個人賽的冠軍，如此類推（男、女子組分開計算，即男、女子組各有名次）。
雨程：
若活動當天中午12時正仍下雨，比賽將會取消。活動消息將在週會末段的宣傳時間公布，同時在眾志堂和嶺南場門外貼出通告，並透過電郵通知參賽者相關消息，敬請留意電郵；
若在報到或比賽期間下雨，大會將視乎雨勢及賽道情況而終止賽事。惟參賽者必須於下午2時40分前報到，並於本學期內把號碼布交還給體育部老師，方可獲4分體育課程活動分。

“Founders' Day Round Campus Run” of The 75th Chung Chi College Founders' Day Student Festival
Dear Students, Staff Members and Alumni,
In celebration of the Chung Chi College 75th Anniversary, the annual “Founders' Day Round Campus Run” will be held on October 30, 2026. This event is not only a challenge of physical strength and perseverance but also a wonderful opportunity to strengthen campus spirit and foster connections among students, faculty, and alumni. Students, staff members, and alumni from Chung Chi College and other colleges of The Chinese University of Hong Kong are all warmly welcome to join. Whether you are an athlete or a running enthusiast, come along to sweat it out and celebrate Chung Chi’s birthday together!
Details
Date:
October 30, 2026（Friday）
Time:
Registration: 2:00 p.m. to 2:40 p.m.
Ceremony & Competition: 2:45 p.m. to 4:00 p.m.
Venue:
Lingnan Stadium of Chung Chi College (Start and Finish points)
Division:
Individuals
Men
Women
Participant:
Students, staff members, and alumni from Chung Chi College and other colleges of The Chinese University of Hong Kong are welcome to join, but only those from Chung Chi College are eligible to receive prizes.
Award:
Champion, first runner-up, and second runner-up will be awarded in both the Men’s and Women’s divisions.
Initial Route:
Lingnan Stadium > CCC Admin Building > Ho Tim Building > CC Chapel > Ho Sin-Hang Engineering Building > William MW Mong Engineering Building > S.H. Ho College > Sir Philip Haddon-Cave Sports Field > Fong Yun Wah Hall > Lingnan Stadium
Remarks:
Runners must check in at the registration counter and collect race bib no later than 2:40 p.m. Late registration will lead to disqualification.
Student runners must tap their student ID card at registration and tap again upon completion of the race. Failure to do so will result in forfeiture of the 4 participation marks in P.E. course.
Runners must complete the race within the 45-minute time limit.
All runners must compete as individuals.
Runners (including staff and alumni) will be divided into Men’s and Women’s divisions.
Runners must wear their assigned bib number and follow the designated route throughout the race.
Runners must not obstruct other runners or use any form of assistance during the race.
Any complaints must be lodged with the officials at the command desk within 10 minutes after the closing of the finish line. Late complaints will not be entertained.
Runners must adhere to all rules above. Violations may lead to disqualification.
Runners are responsible for their personal safety and belongings.
Winners will be determined by finishing order. The fastest finisher in the Men’s and Women’s divisions respectively will be awarded 1st place, followed by 2nd and 3rd places. Rankings are calculated separately for each division.
Rain Plan:
If it rains until 12:00 p.m. on the day of the event, the race will be cancelled. Notifications will be made via email, announced at the end of the Friday Assembly, and posted at the entrance of the Chung Chi Tang and Lingnan Stadium.
If it rains after the event has started, the organizer reserves the right to cancel it based on safety conditions. Regardless of cancellation, runners must check in by 2:40 p.m. and return their bibs to the PE Unit within the semester to receive 4 participation marks in P.E. course.
Interested participants should register for the Round Campus Run at
CC75RoundCampusRun
by October 16, 2026 (Friday)
. Participants who successfully register will receive a confirmation email by October 23 (Friday).
For enquiries, please contact Mr. Walter Lam from the Chaplain’s Office of Chung Chi College at 3943 4301 or via email at
waltelam@cuhk.edu.hk
.

bodyText:

CALL FOR PROPOSALS | Participation in the 17th Chinese National Arctic Research Expedition 2027 | HKPSIC  - Hong Kong Polar Science Innovation Centre
From: Yolanda YIM
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
yolandayim@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
An Opportunity to Conduct Research in Arctic
Regions
__________________________________________________________________________________
The Hong Kong Polar Science Innovation Centre (HKPSIC) is pleased to invite proposals from scientists and researchers interested in participating in the
17th
Chinese National Arctic
Research Expedition 2027
.
Research opportunities are available at
Arctic Ocean Expedition with Xuelong or Xuelong 2, Yellow River Station
and
China-Iceland Arctic Science Observatory (CIAO)
in Arctic Regions. All proposals and personnel nominations will be reviewed and selected by the Polar Research Institute of China (PRIC).
This opportunity is primarily open to researchers from universities in Hong Kong.
Expedition Purpose
The expedition will be conducted for
scientific research purposes
.
Research Opportunities
Arctic Ocean Expedition with Xuelong or Xuelong 2
Quota:
Tentatively 1-2 participants
(Subject to adjustment based on the approved research proposals.)
Eligibility:
PhD candidates
Postdoctoral fellows
Academic staff and researchers
Duration:
Approximately 2–4 months at the station
Tentative departure from Shanghai aboard the icebreaker
Xuelong
or
Xuelong 2
in June or July 2027
Return to Shanghai in Sep or Oct 2027
Additional travel time should be allowed for flights to Shanghai
Yellow River Station
Quota:
1–2 participant(s)
Eligibility:
PhD candidates
Postdoctoral fellows
Academic staff and researchers
Duration:
Approximately 1- 2 week(s) at the station
Tentative departure from Longyearbyen to the station in Aug or Sep
Additional travel time should be allowed for flights to Longyearbyen and from Hong Kong
China-Iceland Arctic Science Observatory (CIAO)
Quota:
1–2 participant(s)
Eligibility:
PhD candidates
Postdoctoral fellows
Academic staff and researchers
Duration:
Approximately 1- 2 week(s) at the station
Tentative departure from Akureyri and drive to the station in Aug or Sep
Additional travel time should be allowed for flights from Hong Kong to Reykjavík, onward travel to Akureyri, and ground transportation to the station.
Priority consideration:
Applicants with existing research collaborations or academic connections in Iceland
Research Instruments
As the icebreakers
Xuelong
and
Xuelong 2
will depart from Shanghai, PRIC recommends that any required research instruments be shipped to Shanghai no later than
Mar-April
for loading and transportation to the Antarctic research stations.
Health and Visa Requirements
Selected participants will be required to:
Complete a medical examination specified by PRIC
Submit a medical report for review
Obtain a Schengen visa for Yellow River Station or CIAO
Participants should allow sufficient time for medical examinations and visa applications.
Clothing and Equipment
PRIC will provide basic expedition clothing and equipment, including:
Expedition jackets
Trousers
Thermal wear
Sunglasses
Other essential gear
These items will be provided to selected participants before departure.
Expenses to Be Covered by Participants
Participants are responsible for all associated expenses, including:
International airfares
Accommodation on the stations before and after station entry/exit or during the expedition in the stations
(Accommodation on Xuelong or Xuelong 2 is provided free of charge)
Travel insurance
Visa application fees (if applicable)
Medical examination fees
Shipment and transportation costs for research instruments and equipment
Any other incidental expenses
Proposal Submission
Researchers who are able to meet the above requirements and schedule are invited to submit an email request to obtain the proposal template.
Submission Deadline
10 November 2026 (Tuesday)
All proposals will be forwarded to PRIC for evaluation and selection. HKPSIC will provide support to participating researchers and facilitate communications with PRIC throughout the application and preparation process.
Enquiries
Secretariat
Hong Kong Polar Science Innovation Centre (HKPSIC)
Email: hkpsic@cuhk.edu.hk
Tel: 3943 0345
We sincerely encourage interested researchers to take advantage of this unique opportunity to conduct scientific research in Arctic Regions and contribute to polar research collaboration.
We look forward to receiving your proposals.
View Count
For request submissions, please submit them at
https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk
Copyright © 2013. All Rights Reserved. The Chinese University of Hong Kong.
/weekly/

中大多元共融節 2026/27
《不同凡響》共融音樂會
一個舞台，不同才能的音樂家，共同奏響超乎想像的無限可能！我們深信「誰都可發光」—— 只要找對地方，自然不同凡響。

dio@cuhk.edu.hk
Dear CUHK colleagues and students,
CUHK Diversity and Inclusion Festival 2026/27
The Inclusive Concert: Beauty of Our Differences
On one stage, diverse music talents come together to create infinite possibilities beyond imagination! We firmly believe that "everyone has the power to shine" — when you find the right stage, you will strike a chord beyond limits.
The Diversity and Inclusion Office will present
“The Inclusive Concert: Beauty of Our Differences”
as the opening event for the CUHK Diversity and Inclusion Festival 2026/27.  The lineup includes:
•
Special Guests:
Renowned singer-songwriter
Panther Chan
and award-winning erhuist and film composer
Chu Wan Pin
•
Featured Artists
from the
Arts with the Disabled Association Hong Kong: Ding Yijie, Malcolm Mok and Anson Tang
•

Your fellow
CUHK student
performers!
From classical masterpieces to contemporary favourites, performers will demonstrate the spirit of diversity and inclusion through collaboration and exchange. Embracing the concept of “harmony in diversity”, the concert celebrates the beauty of differences while allowing the audience to experience the power of human connection through music performance.

Time: 7:00 pm

on or before 27 September 2026 (Sunday)

As GenAI absorbs the foundational work of junior lawyers, how must legal education evolve?
When polished drafting is no longer proof of deep understanding, law schools face a structural reckoning. We must shift from traditional output-driven training to teaching the evaluative demands of supervision, discernment, and ethical stewardship.
Join us to explore this critical transition at our upcoming mini-conference: Legal Education in a GenAI Landscape (LEGAL).

Join us for the launch of Professor Susanne Choi’s new book, Queer Resistance: Contesting State, Family, and Inequality in Post-Socialist China.
Drawing on a decade of research, the book examines how LGBTQ+ people in post-socialist China pursue intimacy, dignity, and belonging while navigating state governance, family expectations, gender norms, and social inequalities.

bodyText:

Join the #ShapeOfLoneliness Instagram Challenge and Win Exciting Prizes!  - Wellness and Counselling Centre, Office of Student Affairs
From: Chu Choi Ying
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
wacc@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Join the #ShapeOfLoneliness Instagram Challenge and Win Exciting Prizes!
Dear Students,
What does loneliness look like to you?
Loneliness can take many forms. It may be a quiet moment between classes, a familiar place seen from a different perspective, or simply time spent alone with your thoughts.
As part of our
"(Un)Seen | Our Moments with Loneliness"
exhibition, the Wellness and Counselling Centre (WACC) invites you to participate in the
#ShapeOfLoneliness Instagram Challenge
and share your unique perspective through photography.
By capturing a moment, place, or scene on campus that reflects loneliness, solitude, reflection, or being with oneself, you will help reveal the many shapes of loneliness experienced within the CUHK community.
Challenge Period
2 October 2026 to 8 October 2026 (9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.)
Get Your Campaign Frame
Collect the official
#ShapeOfLoneliness
campaign frame at:
Venue
Collection Period
Art Fair uShine, uBuddies and uPals Booth
The University Mall
16 to 18 September 2026
WACC Counter
2/F, Pommerenke Student Centre
16 September to 8 October 2026
(First come, first served while stocks last)
How to Participate?
Collect the official campaign frame
Take an original photo within the CUHK campus using the frame
Upload the photo as an Instagram Story during the Challenge Period
Include:
#ShapeOfLoneliness
#UnSeen
#Ourmomentswithloneliness
Tag
@sunshineatcuhk_osa_wacc
Keep the Story visible for at least 24 hours
Take a screenshot of your Story and send it via Instagram Direct Message (DM) to
@sunshineatcuhk_osa_wacc
before the Story expires
Retain the original image and Story screenshot until the winner verification process is completed
Awards & Prizes
Grand Award (1 Winner)
Awarded to the submission that best captures the campaign theme through creativity, originality, visual impact, thoughtful composition, and compelling storytelling.
Prize:
FUJIFILM Instax Mini 13 Instant Camera
Daily Awards (5 Winners)
Awarded to the first eligible verified submission received via DM at or after 9:00 a.m. on each designated award day (time based on DM receipt timestamp):
2, 5, 6, 7 & 8 October.
Prize:
KODAK CHARMERA Digital Camera Blind Box Series
⭐ Merit Awards (50 Winners)
Awarded to the
next ten eligible verified submissions
following the Daily Award winner, ranked by DM submission time on the same day (time based on DM receipt timestamp).
Prize:
Restaurant/ Coffee Shop Coupon (HK$100 each)
Winner Announcement
Winners and prize redemption details will be notified through Instagram Direct Message on or after
19 October 2026
and announced via WACC's communication channels.
We look forward to seeing CUHK through your lens and discovering the many shapes of loneliness together.
參加 #ShapeOfLoneliness Instagram 挑戰贏取豐富獎品！
親愛的同學：
孤獨，對你而言是什麼模樣？
孤獨可以有很多不同的樣子。它可能是課堂之間的一段安靜時光、一個熟悉地方的全新視角，又或者只是與自己相處、沉思的片刻。

Announcements
CUHK "Mind Bathing" — Mindful Nature Connection Guide Training Scheme 中大【心·淋浴】靜觀大自然連結嚮導培訓計劃 - Department of Educational Administration and Policy
From: Cheng Man Sze
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
“Mind Bathing” — Mindful Forest Bathing-inspired Nature Connection Training Scheme
This programme will guide students in a Nature connection at CUHK on 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday) , enabling participants to learn how to connect body and mind through nature. Upon completion, participants will acquire the foundational skills to lead junior secondary students in nature connection, helping adolescents build psychological resilience and mindfulness in their school lives. CUHK students who meet the eligibility criteria are invited to participate in the training and to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing and mindfulness practices on the activity day.
Programme Overview
"Mind Bathing" aims to promote the application of forest bathing (Shinrin-yoku) and nature-based mindfulness in school settings. Through direct experience, participants will learn how to harness the natural environment to enhance physical and mental well-being, and apply these learnings in future educational or community service contexts.
Eligibility Criteria
Undergraduate or postgraduate student at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (all faculties welcome)
Interest in or basic knowledge of forest bathing, mindfulness, or nature-based healing
Able to attend the full forest bathing training session (14 Dec 2026, 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) and at least two mindfulness workshops.
Able to attend the "Mind Bathing" activity on 16 Dec (2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing
Proficient in Cantonese
Sense of responsibility and openness to learning
Interview Arrangements
Date: Mid of October 2026 (specific dates will be notified individually after registration)
Format: Zoom video interview (approximately 5–10 minutes)
Language: Primarily Cantonese
Training Components
1) "Mind Bathing" Guide Training Workshop
Date: 14 Dec 2026 (Monday)/15 Dec 2026(Tuesday ) (Backup)
Time: 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
2) Mind-Body Connection Mindfulness Workshops
Each student guide must attend a minimum of two mindfulness workshops.
Dates:
Mindfulness Foundations: 3 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
Cultivating Emotional Awareness: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
The Wisdom of the Heart: 17 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Connecting with the World: 24 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Venue: CUHK campus (Chung Chi campus), indoor and outdoor
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
3) "Mind Bathing" Junior Secondary Student Service
Date: 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday)/17 Dec 2026(Thursday ) (Backup)
Time: 2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
Programme Content:
Walk along CUHK nature trails to experience forest bathing and connect with nature
Learn mindfulness attitudes and techniques to connect with the present moment
Acquire knowledge and practical applications of psychological resilience
Understand the basic concepts and practices of nature-based healing
Experience engaging with nature through the five senses (sight, hearing, smell, touch, taste)
Introduction to basic guiding techniques and considerations for leading group activities
Fee: Free of charge
Application Method: Applicants please fill in the form by 2026/10/7.
Application Form： https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQGY_OYTa5MSP-wAGrdnm3amX5k1TZP0GZyjkkdmm9Dpftbg/viewform?usp=header
Programme Facilitators
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze
Registered Secondary School Teacher
Promoting mindfulness among undergraduate, pre-service, and in-service teachers since 2007
Senior Lecturer, Department of Educational Administration and Policy, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Partner Organisation: Nature Bathing
A social enterprise with a professional team of forest bathing guides
Specialises in delivering immersive nature-based experiences to help urban dwellers relieve stress
Expert in guiding participants to connect with nature through the five senses for holistic healing
The event is organized by Department of Educational Administration and Policy in CUHK, with the support of the Sustainable Development Goals Action Fund.
Important Notes
Participants are advised to wear comfortable clothing and sports shoes suitable for outdoor activities
In the event of inclement weather, a contingency date or indoor alternative activities will be arranged
Participants who complete the training and service will receive a certificate of attendance acknowledging their training and service hours
This programme is educational in nature and does not constitute clinical treatment
The video of summer session of Mind Bathing Programme is available for watching now!
"Mind Bathing" Video link:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ProyYH4DxccHd1u54Qof6Mlb65IbUnMS/view?usp=sharing
"Mind Bathing" Guide training session video:
https://youtu.be/Wkn2CcHWLqs?si=1sR8j6hKCVUeHBof
Enquiries
For any enquiries regarding this programme, please contact Ms. Cheng:
Email: 1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Programme Coordinators:
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze ; Mr. Wong Chun Kai; Ms. Wong Hiu Lam
Faculty of Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
We look forward to walking with you into the woods and experiencing the healing power of nature!
【心·淋浴 】靜觀大自然連結培訓計劃
本計劃將於2026年12月16日（三）帶領學生在中大進行大自然連結體驗，讓參加者學習如何透過大自然連結身心，並在培訓後具備基本能力，帶領初中學生體驗大自然連結，協助青少年在校園生活中建立心理韌性與靜觀能力。現邀請符合條件的中大學生進行培訓及於活動當日帶領初中生體驗大自然及學習正念。
計劃簡介
「心·淋浴」計劃旨在推廣森林浴 (Shinrin-yoku)、大自然連結及大自然靜觀在校園的應用。參加者將透過親身體驗，學習如何運用大自然環境促進身心靈健康，並將所學應用於教育和社區服務。
招募對象
- 香港中文大學本科生及研究生（就讀任何學科均可）
- 對森林浴、正念或大自然療癒有興趣或具備基本認識
- 能夠出席完整一節大自然連結培訓（12月14日 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. 以及至少兩節正念工作坊
- 能出席12月16日下午1:00-5:00 的「心·淋浴」的活動，帶領初中學生體驗森林浴
- 能夠說利廣東話
- 具備責任心及開放態度
面試安排
日期： 2026年 10月中旬（具體日期將於報名後個別通知）
形式： Zoom 視像面試（約5-10分鐘）
語言： 廣東話為主
培訓內容
1） 「心·淋浴」嚮導培訓工作坊
日期： 2026年12月14日（一）/2026年12月15日（二）（後備）
時間： 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.（共4小時）
地點： 香港中文大學校園（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
2） 心身連結正念工作坊
每位學生嚮導最少要參加兩節正念體驗工作坊。
日期：
- 正念基礎 2026年11月3日（二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm (必須出席)
- 覺察情緒 2026年11月10日 (二） 12:30 pm to 2:00 pm(必須出席)
- 智慧的心 2026年11月17日 (二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm
- 連結世界 2026年11月24日 (二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm
地點：香港中文大學校園 (崇基校園)（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
3） 「心·淋浴」帶領初中學生服務
日期： 2026年12月16日（三）/2026年12月17日（二）（後備）
時間： 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.（共4小時）
地點： 香港中文大學校園（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
內容包括：
1） 遊走中大校園自然徑，連結大自然
2） 學習正念(靜觀)(mindfulness)態度和技巧，連結當下身心靈
3） 學習心理韌性 (Resilience) 相關知識與應用
4） 認識大自然療癒的基本概念與實踐方法
5） 體驗如何透過五感（視、聽、嗅、觸、味）與自然對話
6） 簡單導賞技巧及帶領小組活動的注意事項
費用： 全免
申請方法：申請者請在2026年10月7日或前填寫下列申請表格。
申請表格：https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQGY_OYTa5MSP-wAGrdnm3amX5k1TZP0GZyjkkdmm9Dpftbg/viewform?usp=header
培訓導師
劉雅詩博士
註冊中學教師
自2007年開始為本科生、職前教師和在職教師推廣靜觀(正念)
現任香港中文大學教育行政與政策學系高級講師
合作機構:
遊沐 Nature Bathing
社會企業
專業森林浴嚮導團隊
專注舉辦深度大自然體驗活動，幫助城市人減壓
擅長引導參加者透過五感與自然連結，療癒身心
此活動由香港中文大學教育行政與政策學系主辦，並由可持續發展目標行動資助計劃資助。
備註
參加者需穿著舒適衣物及運動鞋，適合戶外活動
如遇惡劣天氣，將安排後備日期或室內替代活動
完成培訓和服務後，將獲發出席證書以茲證明培訓和服務時數
本計劃工作坊為教育性質，並非臨床治療
歡迎大家觀看我們夏季「心•淋浴」的活動分享影片，有興趣的同學可點擊以下影片鏈接
「心•淋浴」影片: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ProyYH4DxccHd1u54Qof6Mlb65IbUnMS/view?usp=sharing
「心•淋浴」導賞訓練影片: https://youtu.be/Wkn2CcHWLqs?si=1sR8j6hKCVUeHBof
查詢
如閣下對是項計劃有任何查詢，請與鄭小姐聯絡：
電郵：1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
計劃負責人：
香港中文大學教育學院劉雅詩博士; 黃駿佳先生; 黃曉琳同學
期待與你一同走進山林，感受大自然的療癒力量！

Interest in or basic knowledge of forest bathing, mindfulness, or nature-based healing
Able to attend the full forest bathing training session (14 Dec 2026, 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) and at least two mindfulness workshops.
Able to attend the "Mind Bathing" activity on 16 Dec (2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m.) to guide junior secondary students in forest bathing
Proficient in Cantonese
Sense of responsibility and openness to learning
Interview Arrangements
Date: Mid of October 2026 (specific dates will be notified individually after registration)
Format: Zoom video interview (approximately 5–10 minutes)
Language: Primarily Cantonese
Training Components
1) "Mind Bathing" Guide Training Workshop
Date: 14 Dec 2026 (Monday)/15 Dec 2026(Tuesday ) (Backup)
Time: 1:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
2) Mind-Body Connection Mindfulness Workshops
Each student guide must attend a minimum of two mindfulness workshops.
Dates:
Mindfulness Foundations: 3 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
Cultivating Emotional Awareness: 10 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m. (mandatory)
The Wisdom of the Heart: 17 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Connecting with the World: 24 November 2026 (Tuesday), 12:30 p.m. – 2:00 p.m.
Venue: CUHK campus (Chung Chi campus), indoor and outdoor
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
3) "Mind Bathing" Junior Secondary Student Service
Date: 16 Dec 2026 (Wednesday)/17 Dec 2026(Thursday ) (Backup)
Time: 2:00 p.m. – 5:00 p.m. (4 hours)
Venue: CUHK campus (indoor and outdoor)
Language: Primarily Cantonese, with English support
Programme Content:
Walk along CUHK nature trails to experience forest bathing and connect with nature
Learn mindfulness attitudes and techniques to connect with the present moment
Acquire knowledge and practical applications of psychological resilience
Understand the basic concepts and practices of nature-based healing
Experience engaging with nature through the five senses (sight, hearing, smell, touch, taste)
Introduction to basic guiding techniques and considerations for leading group activities
Fee: Free of charge
Application Method: Applicants please fill in the form by 2026/10/7.
Application Form： https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQGY_OYTa5MSP-wAGrdnm3amX5k1TZP0GZyjkkdmm9Dpftbg/viewform?usp=header
Programme Facilitators
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze
Registered Secondary School Teacher
Promoting mindfulness among undergraduate, pre-service, and in-service teachers since 2007
Senior Lecturer, Department of Educational Administration and Policy, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
Partner Organisation: Nature Bathing
A social enterprise with a professional team of forest bathing guides
Specialises in delivering immersive nature-based experiences to help urban dwellers relieve stress
Expert in guiding participants to connect with nature through the five senses for holistic healing
The event is organized by Department of Educational Administration and Policy in CUHK, with the support of the Sustainable Development Goals Action Fund.
Important Notes
Participants are advised to wear comfortable clothing and sports shoes suitable for outdoor activities
In the event of inclement weather, a contingency date or indoor alternative activities will be arranged
Participants who complete the training and service will receive a certificate of attendance acknowledging their training and service hours
This programme is educational in nature and does not constitute clinical treatment
The video of summer session of Mind Bathing Programme is available for watching now!
"Mind Bathing" Video link:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ProyYH4DxccHd1u54Qof6Mlb65IbUnMS/view?usp=sharing
"Mind Bathing" Guide training session video:
https://youtu.be/Wkn2CcHWLqs?si=1sR8j6hKCVUeHBof
Enquiries
For any enquiries regarding this programme, please contact Ms. Cheng:
Email: 1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Programme Coordinators:
Dr. Lau Ngar Sze ; Mr. Wong Chun Kai; Ms. Wong Hiu Lam
Faculty of Education, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
We look forward to walking with you into the woods and experiencing the healing power of nature!
【心·淋浴 】靜觀大自然連結培訓計劃
本計劃將於2026年12月16日（三）帶領學生在中大進行大自然連結體驗，讓參加者學習如何透過大自然連結身心，並在培訓後具備基本能力，帶領初中學生體驗大自然連結，協助青少年在校園生活中建立心理韌性與靜觀能力。現邀請符合條件的中大學生進行培訓及於活動當日帶領初中生體驗大自然及學習正念。
計劃簡介
「心·淋浴」計劃旨在推廣森林浴 (Shinrin-yoku)、大自然連結及大自然靜觀在校園的應用。參加者將透過親身體驗，學習如何運用大自然環境促進身心靈健康，並將所學應用於教育和社區服務。
招募對象
- 香港中文大學本科生及研究生（就讀任何學科均可）
- 對森林浴、正念或大自然療癒有興趣或具備基本認識
- 能夠出席完整一節大自然連結培訓（12月14日 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. 以及至少兩節正念工作坊
- 能出席12月16日下午1:00-5:00 的「心·淋浴」的活動，帶領初中學生體驗森林浴
- 能夠說利廣東話
- 具備責任心及開放態度
面試安排
日期： 2026年 10月中旬（具體日期將於報名後個別通知）
形式： Zoom 視像面試（約5-10分鐘）
語言： 廣東話為主
培訓內容
1） 「心·淋浴」嚮導培訓工作坊
日期： 2026年12月14日（一）/2026年12月15日（二）（後備）
時間： 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.（共4小時）
地點： 香港中文大學校園（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
2） 心身連結正念工作坊
每位學生嚮導最少要參加兩節正念體驗工作坊。
日期：
- 正念基礎 2026年11月3日（二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm (必須出席)
- 覺察情緒 2026年11月10日 (二） 12:30 pm to 2:00 pm(必須出席)
- 智慧的心 2026年11月17日 (二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm
- 連結世界 2026年11月24日 (二）12:30 pm to 2:00 pm
地點：香港中文大學校園 (崇基校園)（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
3） 「心·淋浴」帶領初中學生服務
日期： 2026年12月16日（三）/2026年12月17日（二）（後備）
時間： 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m.（共4小時）
地點： 香港中文大學校園（戶外及室內結合）
語言： 廣東話為主，英語輔助
內容包括：
1） 遊走中大校園自然徑，連結大自然
2） 學習正念(靜觀)(mindfulness)態度和技巧，連結當下身心靈
3） 學習心理韌性 (Resilience) 相關知識與應用
4） 認識大自然療癒的基本概念與實踐方法
5） 體驗如何透過五感（視、聽、嗅、觸、味）與自然對話
6） 簡單導賞技巧及帶領小組活動的注意事項
費用： 全免
申請方法：申請者請在2026年10月7日或前填寫下列申請表格。
申請表格：https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQGY_OYTa5MSP-wAGrdnm3amX5k1TZP0GZyjkkdmm9Dpftbg/viewform?usp=header
培訓導師
劉雅詩博士
註冊中學教師
自2007年開始為本科生、職前教師和在職教師推廣靜觀(正念)
現任香港中文大學教育行政與政策學系高級講師
合作機構:
遊沐 Nature Bathing
社會企業
專業森林浴嚮導團隊
專注舉辦深度大自然體驗活動，幫助城市人減壓
擅長引導參加者透過五感與自然連結，療癒身心
此活動由香港中文大學教育行政與政策學系主辦，並由可持續發展目標行動資助計劃資助。
備註
參加者需穿著舒適衣物及運動鞋，適合戶外活動
如遇惡劣天氣，將安排後備日期或室內替代活動
完成培訓和服務後，將獲發出席證書以茲證明培訓和服務時數
本計劃工作坊為教育性質，並非臨床治療
歡迎大家觀看我們夏季「心•淋浴」的活動分享影片，有興趣的同學可點擊以下影片鏈接
「心•淋浴」影片: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ProyYH4DxccHd1u54Qof6Mlb65IbUnMS/view?usp=sharing
「心•淋浴」導賞訓練影片: https://youtu.be/Wkn2CcHWLqs?si=1sR8j6hKCVUeHBof
查詢
如閣下對是項計劃有任何查詢，請與鄭小姐聯絡：
電郵：1155235728@link.cuhk.edu.hk
計劃負責人：
香港中文大學教育學院劉雅詩博士; 黃駿佳先生; 黃曉琳同學
期待與你一同走進山林，感受大自然的療癒力量！

The Chinese version follows the English version of this email.
Multicultural Psychological Support Service: Counselling Service for Non-Local Students
No matter where we come from, we all desire to express our emotional needs with no barrier. Speaking in our mother tongue with someone who shares our cultural background not only allows us to better articulate ourselves but also fosters a deeper sense of understanding.
In order to support CUHK non-local students, the Wellness and Counselling Centre (WACC) of the Office of Student Affairs (OSA) offers Multicultural Psychological Support Service. This service allows students to receive counselling services in a comfortable environment.
The service is provided by St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service, and it is available to all CUHK full-time non-local students. The counsellors from St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service are capable of providing counselling services in English or Putonghua, as well as other languages including English, Putonghua, French, German, Dutch, Spanish, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Portuguese, Korean, Urdu, Russian, Sindhi and Tagalog (subject to counsellor’s availability). Below are the specific details of the services provided:
Location:
St John’s Cathedral Counselling Service
Address:
10th Floor, Two Chinachem Plaza, 68 Connaught Road, Central
Website:
https://www.sjccs.hk/
Service Period:
July 2026 to June 2027
Opening hours:
9AM to 9PM Monday to Saturday, except on Public Holiday
Service Target:
All CUHK full-time non-local students, including exchange students.
Local students with extensive exposure to cultural experiences outside Hong Kong are also eligible (e.g. with international school backgrounds, or ethnic minorities born in Hong Kong).
Session:
6 counselling sessions
For more information about the Multicultural Psychological Support Service, please visit
OSA WACC website
or contact WACC staff at 3943 9951 or 3943 7208.
How can I make an appointment?
Enroll online by webform:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733096
If you have an urgent need to see a counsellor, you may visit WACC during office hours. The Duty Counsellor will assess your needs and make appropriate arrangements with you. If you need emotional support during non-office hours, please call the CUHK 24-hour Emotional Support Hotline at 5400 2055 (exclusively for CUHK Full-time Students and Part-time PGDE Students).
Enquiries:
Contact number: 3943 9951/ 3943 7208
Email:
mpss@cuhk.edu.hk
/
wacc@cuhk.edu.hk
Best regards,
Multicultural Psychological Support Service (MPSS)
Wellness and Counselling Centre
Office of Student Affairs
3/F Pommerenke Student Centre, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shatin, N.T.
T: +852 3943 9951   E:
mpss@cuhk.edu.hk
多元文化心理支援服務
為非本地學生提供母語輔導服務
無論來自哪裡，我們都渴望輕鬆地表達感受。用母語與有相似文化背景的人交談，不僅讓我們能清楚表達自己，還可增強更深層次的理解。為支援非本地同學，學生事務處心理健康及輔導中心推出「多元文化心理支援服務」，讓同學可在舒服自在的情況下打開心扉。
輔導服務由中環聖約翰座堂輔導服務提供，服務對象為所有香港中文大學全日制非本地學生。輔導員除了能提供以英語或普通話為母語的輔導服務外，亦能以法語、德語、荷蘭語、西班牙語、印地語、印尼語、日語、葡萄牙語、韓語、烏爾都語、俄語、信德語和他加祿語等其他語言進行輔導。服務詳情如下：
服務提供者：
聖約翰座堂輔導服務中心
服務地址：
中環幹諾道中
68
號華懋廣場Ⅱ期
10
樓
網址：
https://www.sjccs.hk/
服務時段：
2026年7月至2027年六月
營業時間：
週一至週六上午 9 時至晚上 9 時，公眾假期除外
服務對象：
香港中文大學全日制非本地學生，包括交換生
本地學生如有豐富的非本地文化背景（如曾就讀國際學校，或在香港出生的少數族裔人士）亦可申請
輔導次數：
提供6次輔導服務
有關「多元文化心理支援服務」的詳情，請瀏覽
學生事務處心理健康及輔導中心網頁
或致電3943 9951或3943 7208向心理健康及輔導中心職員查詢。
如何預約輔導服務？
於網上預約:
https://cloud.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk/webform/view.php?id=13733096
如急需與輔導員見面，可於辦公時間內到訪位於龐萬倫學生中心2樓的心理健康及輔導中心。當值的輔導員會評估同學的需要，並作出適當的安排。如欲在非辦公時間尋求情緒支援，歡迎致電中大24小時情緒支援熱線5400 2055（僅供中文大學全日制學生及兼讀制學位教師教育文憑學生使用）。
查詢：
致電：3943 9951/3943 7208
電郵：
mpss@cuhk.edu.hk

title: Up to HK$150! Participate in a 1-Hour In-Person Decision-Making Experiment ｜ 最高可獲HK$150！誠邀參加1小時實體決策實驗
bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/25
»
Announcements
Up to HK$150! Participate in a 1-Hour In-Person Decision-Making Experiment ｜ 最高可獲HK$150！誠邀參加1小時實體決策實驗 - Department of Decisions, Operations and Technology
From: Ziling Feng
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
ziling.feng@link.cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
我們誠摯邀請您參加由香港中文大學（中大）的
Philip Zhang 教授
及
Jenny Jin 教授
開展的線下面對面決策實驗！
本研究旨在更深入了解人們在面對排隊情況時如何作出決策。在實驗過程中，您將閱讀實驗說明、完成理解測試，並參與一系列決策任務。
實驗形式： 線下面對面實驗
預計時長： 約1小時
地點： 香港中文大學 CYT 928
實驗日期及時間：
2026年9月28日（星期一），下午2:00–4:00
2026年9月30日（星期三），下午2:00–4:00
2026年10月5日（星期一），下午2:00–4:00
2026年10月7日（星期三），下午2:00–4:00
如果以上時段均不適合您，您仍可報名，以便獲取未來實驗的相關資訊。
報酬：
完成實驗後，您將獲得港幣70元的基本報酬，並根據您在實驗中的決策及結果獲得額外的績效獎金。您合共最高可獲港幣150元。
參加要求：
年滿18歲；
能夠閱讀並理解以英文撰寫的實驗說明；
實驗期間必須攜帶個人手提電腦以供使用。
重要提示：
實驗必須獨立完成。實驗期間不得使用 ChatGPT 或任何其他生成式人工智能工具。
報名：
有興趣參加嗎？請點擊以下連結填寫報名表格，並選擇合適的實驗時段：
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_aeGME6OAccohAaO
參與本研究完全出於自願。所有收集的匿名數據均會保密，並僅用於科學研究用途。
如有任何疑問，請聯絡：ziling.feng@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Department of Decisions, Operations, and Technology
The Chinese University of Hong Kong
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We cordially invite you to participate in an in-person decision-making experiment conducted  by
Prof. Philip Zhang
and
Prof. Jenny Jin
at The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)!
This study aims to better understand how people make decisions when facing a queue. During the experiment, you will read the experiment instructions, complete comprehension checks, and participate in a series of decision-making tasks.
Experiment Format: In-person experiment
Estimated Duration: Approximately 1 hour
Location: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, CYT 928
Experiment Period:
Monday, 28 September 2026, 2:00–4:00 p.m.
Wednesday, 30 September 2026, 2:00–4:00 p.m.
Monday, 5 October 2026, 2:00–4:00 p.m.
Wednesday, 7 October  2026, 2:00–4:00 p.m.
If none of these times work for you, you may still sign up to hear about future experiments.
Compensation:
Upon completing the experiment, you will receive a base payment of HK$70, plus an additional performance-based bonus depending on your decisions and outcomes during the experiment. You may receive up to HK$150 in total.
Participation Requirements:
Aged 18 or above;
Able to read and understand the experiment instructions in English；
Must bring a personal laptop for use during the experiment.
Important Note:
The experiment must be completed independently. The use of ChatGPT or any other generative AI tools during the experiment is not permitted.
Enrollment:
Interested in participating? Please click the link below to complete the enrollment form and select a suitable experiment time slot:
https://cuhk.qualtrics.com/jfe/form/SV_aeGME6OAccohAaO
Participation in this study is entirely voluntary. All anonymous data collected will be kept confidential and used solely for scientific research purposes.
If you have any questions, please contact: ziling.feng@link.cuhk.edu.hk
Department of Decisions, Operations, and Technology
The Chinese University of Hong Kong

[Ready for Co-op@CUHK?
Essential Application and Interview Tips]
Calling CUHK Year 2 or above undergraduate students across all disciplines! We are excited to announce that
application
for the 6th Cohort of Co-op@CUHK are now open!
As Hong Kong's first university-wide co-operative education programme,
Co-op@CUHK
empowers students to develop essential workplace skills, expand their professional networks, and gain valuable industry experience through:
Comprehensive Pre-employment Training
2 credit-bearing preparatory courses
A wide range of career development and professional enrichment activities
A 6-to-8 Month Full-time Placement
Local and non-local placement opportunities across diverse industries
Full-credit, full-time, and full-paid professional experience
Check out the following application and interview tips to help you get ready for your Co-op journey!
(PS:
Final Year Students
may download the study plan template
here
)
The selection interview is an opportunity for the admission panel to get to know you better, while giving you a chance to learn more about the Co-op Programme. Most importantly, stay calm, be authentic, and let your strengths shine through.
Apply here
and take the first step towards an unforgettable learning journey.
Stay connected with us on
LinkedIn
and
IG
for the latest updates.
If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to our team at
coop@cuhk.edu.hk
or call 3943 5674 / 3943 1422.
Best regards,
Office of Co-operative Education Programme

bodyText:
Mass Mail System
Mass Mail System
Digest of CUHK Mass Mails for Undergraduate Students
»
2026/09/25
»
Announcements
Invitation for an online mental health course study for individuals with depression or anxiety symptoms [Earn max. HKD280] 邀請正經歷抑鬱或焦慮症狀的人士參與網上心理健康課程研究 [最高可獲港幣$280答謝金] - Psychology
From: Alan Tong
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
alantong@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
網上心理健康課程研究
參加者招募
我們誠摯邀請你參與心理學系的一項研究，旨在更深入了解網上心理健康課程提供的不同內容如何影響使用者的參與度。這項研究為期大約四個月，期間你將獲邀填寫5份網上問卷，每份約需10分鐘完成。為感謝你的寶貴時間和投入，你最多可獲得總值港幣280元現金券作為回饋。你的回應對我們日後的服務優化極為重要。

我們正在招募能夠滿足以下條件的參加者：
年滿十八歲
能使用互聯網
懂得使用電子設備（包括：電腦、手機或平板電腦）
能閱讀和理解中文或英文
正在經歷抑鬱或焦慮症狀，且困擾持續2個月。（由研究人員篩選評估）
在過去三個月內未曾參與賽馬會心導遊+平台上的認知行為課程（針對抑鬱焦慮情緒）及其相關研究項目

參與研究，你將會：
完成篩查調查確認參加資格
*
完成前測問卷（需時大約10分鐘）
在6星期內完成8個單元的網上心理健康課程
每完成一個單元後，參加者將會透過他們的電郵及平台郵箱獲得相應的文字反饋，及填寫簡短單元問卷（約3分鐘）
在完成整個課程，完成課程後的一個月及三個月後分別完成後測、跟進1及跟進2問卷
參加者將會被隨機分派到三組：實驗組1、實驗組2或對照組，並獲得一個網上心理健康平台的帳戶進行本研究設計的課程。參加者需要在其後的6星期研究期間
每星期登入平台至少兩次、且每次花大約
15
分鐘完成學習一個單元（總共
8
個單元）
。
 為答謝你所付出的時間，在研究完成後你最高可獲得總值港幣
280
元
現金券#！
*
由於名額有限，若果報名人數過多，將會隨機抽取部分合資格人士參與研究，問卷將透過電郵發送，並需要在收到後的四日內完成。
#
經實驗驗人員確認後，現金券會分三次在完成
跟進
2
問卷後
3
個月內
派發。
如你對此項研究感興趣，請立即點擊以下連結或掃描QR code了解詳情並報名登記！
https://esurvey.psy.cuhk.edu.hk/jfe/form/SV_5d2mVuE84SVimk6
本研究已獲得香港中文大學調查及行為研究倫理委員會 (編號：SBRE‐24‐0541)。
Study on Online Mental Health Course
Recruitment of Participants
We’re reaching out to invite you to join an important study conducted by the Department of Psychology, to better understand how different elements in online mental health courses influence user engagement. The study will last for approximately four months, during which you will be asked to complete 5 online questionnaires, each taking about 10 minutes. To thank you for your valuable time and effort, you can receive up to HK$280 in cash vouchers. Your responses are crucial for our current services’ future improvement.
The study is looking for
:
Aged 18 or above
Able to access the internet
Able to use electronic devices (e.g., computers, smartphones, or tablets)
Able to read and understand Chinese or English
Experiencing symptoms of depression or anxiety, lasting for 2 months or more (to be screened and assessed by researchers)
Have not previously participated in the Jockey Club TourHeart+ platform’s cognitive behavioral courses (targeting depression and anxiety) or related research projects
What will you have to do?
Complete a screening survey to check for eligibility
*
Complete a pre-test questionnaire (approximately 10 minutes)
Complete an 8-units online mental health course (over 6 weeks)
After completing each unit and receiving text feedback via email and the platform’s inbox, complete a short unit questionnaire (approximately 3 minutes)
Complete Post-test, Follow-up 1 (one month after course completion), and Follow-up 2 (three months after course completion) questionnaires
Participants will be randomly assigned to one of three groups: Experimental Group 1, Experimental Group 2, or the Control Group. You will receive an account for an online mental health platform to access the study-designed course. During the 4-week study period,
you will need to log into the platform at least twice per week, spending approximately 15 minutes per session to complete one unit (a total of 8 units)
.
As a token of appreciation for your time, you can receive up to a maximum of
HKD280
in cash vouchers upon completion of the study#!
*
Due to limited availability, if the number of registrations exceeds the capacity, a random selection of eligible individuals will be made. The questionnaire will be sent via email and need to be completed within four days of receiving it.
#
After verification by the research team, cash vouchers will be distributed within 3 months after completing the Follow-up 2 questionnaire.
If you are interested in this study, now please click the link below or scan the QR code to get more information and register now!
https://esurvey.psy.cuhk.edu.hk/jfe/form/SV_5d2mVuE84SVimk6
This study has been approved by the Survey and Behavioural Research Ethics Committee of CUHK (Reference No.: SBRE‐24‐0541).

For enquiries, please write to:
http://servicedesk.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

。
 為答謝你所付出的時間，在研究完成後你最高可獲得總值港幣
280
元
現金券#！
*
由於名額有限，若果報名人數過多，將會隨機抽取部分合資格人士參與研究，問卷將透過電郵發送，並需要在收到後的四日內完成。
#
經實驗驗人員確認後，現金券會分三次在完成
跟進
2
問卷後
3
個月內
派發。
如你對此項研究感興趣，請立即點擊以下連結或掃描QR code了解詳情並報名登記！
https://esurvey.psy.cuhk.edu.hk/jfe/form/SV_5d2mVuE84SVimk6
本研究已獲得香港中文大學調查及行為研究倫理委員會 (編號：SBRE‐24‐0541)。
Study on Online Mental Health Course
Recruitment of Participants
We’re reaching out to invite you to join an important study conducted by the Department of Psychology, to better understand how different elements in online mental health courses influence user engagement. The study will last for approximately four months, during which you will be asked to complete 5 online questionnaires, each taking about 10 minutes. To thank you for your valuable time and effort, you can receive up to HK$280 in cash vouchers. Your responses are crucial for our current services’ future improvement.
The study is looking for
:
Aged 18 or above
Able to access the internet
Able to use electronic devices (e.g., computers, smartphones, or tablets)
Able to read and understand Chinese or English
Experiencing symptoms of depression or anxiety, lasting for 2 months or more (to be screened and assessed by researchers)
Have not previously participated in the Jockey Club TourHeart+ platform’s cognitive behavioral courses (targeting depression and anxiety) or related research projects
What will you have to do?
Complete a screening survey to check for eligibility
*
Complete a pre-test questionnaire (approximately 10 minutes)
Complete an 8-units online mental health course (over 6 weeks)
After completing each unit and receiving text feedback via email and the platform’s inbox, complete a short unit questionnaire (approximately 3 minutes)
Complete Post-test, Follow-up 1 (one month after course completion), and Follow-up 2 (three months after course completion) questionnaires
Participants will be randomly assigned to one of three groups: Experimental Group 1, Experimental Group 2, or the Control Group. You will receive an account for an online mental health platform to access the study-designed course. During the 4-week study period,
you will need to log into the platform at least twice per week, spending approximately 15 minutes per session to complete one unit (a total of 8 units)
.
As a token of appreciation for your time, you can receive up to a maximum of
HKD280
in cash vouchers upon completion of the study#!
*
Due to limited availability, if the number of registrations exceeds the capacity, a random selection of eligible individuals will be made. The questionnaire will be sent via email and need to be completed within four days of receiving it.
#
After verification by the research team, cash vouchers will be distributed within 3 months after completing the Follow-up 2 questionnaire.
If you are interested in this study, now please click the link below or scan the QR code to get more information and register now!
https://esurvey.psy.cuhk.edu.hk/jfe/form/SV_5d2mVuE84SVimk6
This study has been approved by the Survey and Behavioural Research Ethics Committee of CUHK (Reference No.: SBRE‐24‐0541).

[Register Now!] [9 OCT] Areas of Excellence (AoE) Use data to transform diabetes care and patient lives - Live Webinar Series (2026-2027)  - Hong Kong Institute of Diabetes and Obesity
From: LAU Wing Man
For comments and enquiries related to this message, please send to
hkido@cuhk.edu.hk
- - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -
Dear All,
You’re cordially invited to join
Areas of Excellence (AoE)
Use data to transform diabetes care and patient lives
Live Webinar Series (2026-2027)
with the details below:
Join us for the
Areas of Excellence (AoE) Live Webinar Series (2026-2027)
which we have invited global leaders and experts in biomedical-psychosocial-behavioral science to share the latest knowledge in epidemiology, diagnosis, prevention and treatment from early to late stage in pursuit of the vision of the Lancet Commission Report on diabetes.
In this monthly webinar, we have invited experts to discuss the challenges and opportunities of implementing data-driven diabetes prevention and care and explore opportunities of setting a Global Diabetes Register using the JADE Platform in our common goal of making healthcare sustainable and helping people live a healthy and better life.
Learning objectives
Understand what, why, how, by whom and for whom of setting up diabetes registers
Set up a network of collaborators to establish a multicounty JADE Register with automatic data anonymization, using common protocol to gather real world evidence, share best practices and improve quality of care
Enable researchers and care providers to work collectively to define the clinical profiles of their population, benchmark their care performance, establish biobanks and implement pragmatic clinical studies to address unmet needs
About the speaker
Professor Edward GREGG, Chair and Head of School, Royal College of Surgeons in Ireland, School of Population Health, Dublin, Ireland
Professor Hongjiang WU, Assistant Professor, Department of Medicine and Therapeutics, Faculty of Medicine, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, HKSAR, China
Date & time: 9 October 2026 (Friday) | 17:00-18:00 HKT (UTC+8)
Online: via Zoom — link provided upon registration
Register
HERE
To learn more, please visit
HERE
Don’t miss this opportunity for setting up the JADE Register at your institution with access to the portal for a trial period to explore feasibility.
Acknowledgement of the RGC Area of Excellence Scheme on Diabetes (AoE/M-401/24-R).

https://cumassmail.itsc.cuhk.edu.hk

** 初級課程 - 學生$630，職員 (及家屬) $700

** 第二級 - 學生$1360，職員 (及家屬) $1480

注意：
參加者須能穿著衣服及救生衣游泳50米。課程首日可能會安排游泳測試。
水上活動對體能有一定要求，參加者應確保身體狀況適合參與相關活動。
課程將以廣東話授課，並輔以英語說明。
報名一經確認後，恕不接受退款、更改課程或更換參加者（包括因疾病而未能出席的情況）。惟因惡劣天氣、報名人數不足或本中心取消課程而導致的情況除外。
如參與風帆基本技巧訓練班須持有中國香港帆船運動總會風帆入門（第一級）證書或中國香港帆船運動總會少年帆船第三級：舵手進階證書或康文署風帆入門訓練班100%出席證明或康文署少年帆船第三級：舵手進階資歷證明
報讀獨木舟二星證書課程或以上級別的參加者，必須於報名時出示相關資歷證明。未能提供有效證書者，本中心有權拒絕其報名申請。
參加者必須年滿14歲。18歲以下人士須取得家長、監護人或授權人士同意；16歲以下人士須由家長、監護人或授權人士陪同參與活動。陪同人士必須年滿 18歲。
課程費用僅包括教練費及器材使用費。成功完成課程並通過考核者，可申請相關證書。證書費用需另行支付：獨木舟$45、滑浪風帆$30及帆船$55 / $115
參加者須於課程當日自行前往水上活動中心集合。請自備泳衣、長袖上衣、適合下水使用且包趾包跟的運動鞋，以及午餐。
如報名人數不足，本中心保留取消課程的權利。受影響的參加者將獲個別電郵通知。
體育部將為出席率達 100% 的學生提供培訓津貼：獨木舟訓練($90)，滑浪風帆及帆船訓練($200)，津貼將於課程完成後發還。缺席或中途退出課程者將不獲發放津貼。

From: Office of Student Affairs

[External activity] L.I.O.N. 2027
To encourage young people to assist peers in overcoming the difficulties they face in their development and to resist temptation of drugs, the Narcotics Bureau of the Hong Kong Police Force founded the “Leadership Institute on Narcotics” (L.I.O.N.) in 2021 with the support of various sectors of the community and recruited 100 secondary and university students over the territory as mentees each year. Through providing systematic training by expertise from different professions and offering guidance on design and implementation of anti-drug activities by mentors, L.I.O.N. aims to foster mentees’ sense of social responsibility and nurture them into outstanding young anti-drug leaders.
L.I.O.N. 2027 is now open for applications! The institute offers a range of practical training, covering topics like drug prevention knowledge – its effects on mind and body and legal applications, leadership skills development and project management, multimedia creation and hands-on promotion techniques, and courses on generative AI applications. Mentees will receive systematic training on drug knowledge and leadership skills throughout the year, and university mentees will lead secondary school mentees to implement anti-drug campaigns under the guidance of their mentors.
On top of the originally planned series of local training sessions, the upcoming 2025/26 L.I.O.N. will be continued to organize a field trip to the Mainland which aims to deepen mentees’ understanding on the national anti-drug strategies and latest developments in the Mainland. An overseas trip will also be offered to outstanding mentees. Mentees will also receive leadership training from professional instructors, apply their learning by leading teams of secondary school students, gain first-hand exposure to the work of officers from the Narcotics Bureau, participate in large-scale events, and have opportunities to be featured in media interviews.
Link for application
Please download and complete the application form (
https://www.police.gov.hk/info/doc/drug/lion/2026/lion_af_u.docx
), and submit it via email to
lion-nb@police.gov.hk
Application deadline
31 October 2026
(Due to limited quotas, applications submitted on or before 30 September 2026 will be given priority for an interview.)
More on L.I.O.N.:
https://www.police.gov.hk/ppp_tc/04_crime_matters/drug/lion.html
For any enquiry, please contact Intelligence Division 1E of Narcotics Bureau at 2860 3397. Thank you!
Best regards,
Student Experience and Development Section
Office of Student Affairs
[校外活動] 「禁毒領袖學院2027」大學學員招募
為鼓勵青年們協助朋輩克服成長過程中所遇到的困難、不隨俗浮沉，抵抗各種誘惑，在社會各界支持下，香港警務處毒品調查科於2021年成立「禁毒領袖學院」，並每年於全港挑選100名中學及大學生成為學員。來自不同專業領域的顧問提供系統化的訓練，並透過小組導師帶領學員設計及執行抗毒活動，激發學員的社會責任感，栽培每一位學員成為優秀的青年禁毒領袖。
「禁毒領袖學院2027」現正招募學員！學院提供一系列實用培訓，內容涵蓋禁毒知識 - 身心影響與法律應用、領袖才能培養與項目管理、多媒體創作與實戰宣傳技巧、生成式AI應用課程等。學員會接受為期一年有關毒品知識及領導才能的系統化培訓，並在小組導師指導下，由大學學員帶領中學學員執行抗毒活動。
除了一系列本地培訓活動外，新一屆「禁毒領袖學院」會繼續安排學員到內地考察，以了解國內抗毒策略及國家最新發展。表現優異的學員更有機會獲得獎學金及海外交流機會。學員還將獲專業團隊培訓領袖才能、實踐所學帶領中學生團隊、直擊毒品調查科人員工作、亮相於大型活動及接受訪問等。
表格下載
填妥申請表 (
https://www.police.gov.hk/info/doc/drug/lion/2026/lion_af_u.docx
)後，電郵至
lion-nb@police.gov.hk
截止報名日期
2026 年 10 月 31 日
(於2026年9月30日或之前遞交申請，可獲安排優先面試 )
更多有關「禁毒領袖學院」詳情，請參閱：

「禁毒領袖學院2027」現正招募學員！學院提供一系列實用培訓，內容涵蓋禁毒知識 - 身心影響與法律應用、領袖才能培養與項目管理、多媒體創作與實戰宣傳技巧、生成式AI應用課程等。學員會接受為期一年有關毒品知識及領導才能的系統化培訓，並在小組導師指導下，由大學學員帶領中學學員執行抗毒活動。
除了一系列本地培訓活動外，新一屆「禁毒領袖學院」會繼續安排學員到內地考察，以了解國內抗毒策略及國家最新發展。表現優異的學員更有機會獲得獎學金及海外交流機會。學員還將獲專業團隊培訓領袖才能、實踐所學帶領中學生團隊、直擊毒品調查科人員工作、亮相於大型活動及接受訪問等。

Two workshops and one lecture exploring storytelling, performance, and creativity.
今個學期，給自己一次走進劇場的機會
故事如何創作?
演員如何經歷？
兩個工作坊加一個講座，帶你從創作、表演到交流，全方位探索劇場的無限可能。

歡迎所有中大同學參加，無須任何戲劇經驗。
1.
劇場文本創作工作坊 (Script Writing Workshop)

如果你有故事想說，這將會是最好的開始。
無需創作經驗，只要你對說故事或劇場感到好奇，就歡迎加入。
Have a story to tell? Start here.
透過寫作探索創意與想像力  (Explore imagination through writing)
學習劇本創作的基本技巧  (Learn the basics of scriptwriting)
從人物出發，建立屬於自己的故事  (Build your own characters and stories)
日期 (Date)：
2026.10.07 - 2026.11.11 (Every Wednesday）
時間 (Time)：
18:45 - 21:45
地點 (Location)：
邵逸夫堂 (Sir Run Run Shaw Hall)

活動頁面
)

現已延長報名截止日期 (Deadline)
：2026.9.29 - 17:00
2.
演員初體驗工作坊
(
The First Take Workshop)

我/演員/角色，其實都離不開「我」，
透過不同練習，開發肢體、探索聲音、加強空間意識和節奏感、深化想像力。
帶著第三隻眼睛，連結自己觀察世界，
讓不同的「我」和「我」在生活/表演的舞台美好的相遇。
Explore movement, voice, rhythm, and imagination.
Discover new perspectives and bring yourself to the stage.
日期 (Date)：
2026.10.13 - 2026.11.3 (Every Tuesday）
時間 (Time)：
18:45 - 21:45
地點 (Location)：
邵逸夫堂 (Sir Run Run Shaw Hall)
Register Now
(詳情參閱
活動頁面
)

報名截止日期 (Deadline)
：2026.9.30 - 13:00

由本地資深藝評人陳瑋鑫帶領大家在本地的創意迷霧中疏理分析，
認識當代重要創作人及其代表作品，分享戲劇欣賞技巧，
幫助你從不同角度了解表演藝術，開啟屬於自己的劇場之旅。
Discover influential artists, remarkable works, and the art of theatre appreciation.

【 inno330 X InnoPort —— Inno Barista Program 現正接受報名】
你鍾意飲咖啡，但又唔止係鍾意飲咖啡？
你有冇諗過一杯咖啡可以連結創業、社會創新同共融體驗？
InnoPort 聯同 inno330 推出 Inno Barista Program，透過咖啡連結社區，體驗社企營運，同志同道合嘅同學一齊構思創新方案。
你將會：
有機會聆聽社企專家 Prof. Howard Ling 親身分享，傳授社企創業心法、集資策略同可持續營運嘅實戰智慧
與復元人士並肩實習，親身感受共融點樣喺日常中發生
跟隨擁有30+年經驗嘅業界導師 Ben Lam 學習專業咖啡技術
同其他參加者一齊 co-create，設計你嘅夢想咖啡店，並親身 Pitch 創意 idea
名額有限，機會難得！
截止報名：2026年9月27日
專為中大學生而設 (所有參加者須能以流利粵語進行日常溝通及討論)
報名：
https://forms.gle/L7KaCGxY6pgFEpEeA
【 inno330 X InnoPort — Inno Barista Program Now Open for Applications】
Have you ever imagined that a cup of coffee could connect entrepreneurship, social innovation, and inclusion?
InnoPort and inno330 are joining hands to launch the Inno Barista Program, an experiential journey that brings together specialty coffee, social entrepreneurship, and community engagement. Through hands-on learning and collaboration, participants will explore how innovative ideas can create meaningful social impact.
You will have the opportunity to:
Learn from social enterprise expert Prof. Howard Ling, who will share insights on social entrepreneurship, fundraising strategies, and sustainable business practices
Work alongside individuals in recovery and experience how inclusion can be fostered in everyday life

From: Noelle Au Yeung

The KIIDD Symposium 2026 will be held from October 12 to 14, 2026, in Liwen Hall at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen. Organized by the Kobilka Institute of Innovative Drug Discovery (KIIDD) and co-organized by the Warshel Institute for Computational Biology, this premier event will convene Nobel Laureates, internationally renowned scholars, and rising young scientists for in-depth dialogue on the molecular foundations of life, the mechanisms underlying complex diseases, and the discovery and translation of innovative drugs.
香港中文大學（深圳）醫學院旗下兩大諾獎得主研究院——科比爾卡創新藥物開發研究院與瓦謝爾計算生物學研究院聯合主辦的 「KIIDD Membrane Protein Structure, Dynamics and Signaling & Drug Discovery Innovation Symposium 2026」，將於 2026 年 10 月 12 日至 14 日在香港中文大學（深圳）隆重舉行。本次研討會以「膜蛋白結構、動態與信號轉導暨創新藥物研發為主題，深度整合了從「計算生物學類比」到「濕實驗驗證與藥物開發」的全方位前沿視野。會議匯聚了包括諾貝爾獎得主 Brian Kobilka 教授在內的數十位國際頂尖學者與青年科學家，針對 G 蛋白偶聯受體（GPCR）、離子通道、AI 輔助藥物設計以及細胞信號轉導機制等領域展開深入研討，致力於加速將結構生物學突破轉化為下一代創新療法。
Date
: October 12 to 14, 2026
Venue
: Liwen Hall, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

.

From: Phoebe Chan

mastersleep@cuhk.edu.hk
